a: Mishna echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira, shenneemar: "mishpat echad yihye lachem".

Ma ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot? dine mamonot – bishlosha, vedine nefashot – beesrim ushelosha. dine mamonot – potchin ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot – potchin lizchut veen potchin lechova.
Dine mamonot – mattin al pi echad, ben lizchut ben lechova, vedine nefashot – mattin al pi echad lizchut, veal pi shenayim lechova.
Dine mamonot – machzirin ben lizchut ben lechova, dine nefashot – machzirin lizchut veen machzirin lechova.
Dine mamonot – hakkol melammedin zechut vechova, dine nefashot – hakkol melammedin zechut, veen hakkol melammedin chova.
Dine mamonot – hamelammed chova melammed zechut, vehamelammed zechut melammed chova. dine nefashot – hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut en yachol lachzor ulelammed chova.
Dine mamonot – danin bayyom, vegomrin ballayla. dine nefashot – danin bayyom, vegomrin bayyom.
Dine mamonot – gomrin bo bayyom, ben lizchut ben lechova. dine nefashot – gomrin bo bayyom lizchut, uvayyom shelleacharav lechova. lefichach, en danin lo beerev shabbat velo beerev yom tov.
Dine mamonot, hattemaot vehatteharot – matchilin min haggadol. dine nefashot – matchilin min hatztzad.
Hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot, veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot, ella kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim hammassiin lakkehunna.

Gemara dine mamonot mi baenan derisha vachakira? ureminhu: shetar shezzemanno katuv beechad benisan bashshemitta, uvau edim veamru: "heach attem meidin al shetar ze? vahalo beyom peloni immanu heyitem bemakom peloni!" shetar kasher veedav kesherin. chayyshinan shemma icharuhu uchetavuhu.
Vei salka datach baenan derisha vachakira, hechi chayyshinan shemma icharuhu uchetavuhu?
Velitamaych, tikshe lach matnitin: shitre chov hammukedamin pesulim, vehameucharim kesherin. vei salka datach baenan derisha vachakira, meucharin ammay kesherin?

Ha la kashya, daadifa minna kaamrinan. daafillu echad benisan bishmitta, dela shechichi inashe demozfi, delekka lememar shemma icharuhu uchetavuhu dela mara lishtareh, afillu hachi, kevan dishviit sofah meshammetet – machsherinan.
Mikkol makom, kashya. siman: 588.

Amar rabbi chanina: devar tora, echad dine mamonot veechad dine nefashot bidrisha uvachakira, shenneemar: "mishpat echad yihye lachem". uma taam amru dine mamonot la baenan derisha vachakira? kede shello tinol delet bifne lovin.
Ella meatta
b: Tau – lo yeshallemu? kol shekken shettinol delet bifne lovin!
Rava amar: matnitin dehacha bedine kenasot, veiddach behodaot vehalevaot.
Rav pappa amar: idde veidde behodaa vehalevaa. kan – bedin merumme, kan – bedin sheeno merumme.
Kidresh lakish, deresh lakish rame: ketiv "betzedek tishpot amitecha", uchetiv "tzedek tzedek tirdof". ha ketzad? kan – bedin merumme, kan – bedin sheen merumme.
Rav ashe amar: matnitin kidshannin, kerae echad ledin veechad lifshara.

Kidtanya: "tzedek tzedek tirdof" – echad ledin veechad lifshara. ketzad? shete sefinot ovrot bannahar ufagu ze baze, im ovrot shetehen – shetehen tovot, beze achar ze – shetehen ovrot. vechen shene gemallim shehayu olim bemaalot bet choron ufagu ze baze, im alu shenehen – shenehen noflin, beze achar ze – shenehen olin.

Ha ketzad? teuna vesheenah teuna – tiddache sheenah teuna mippene teuna. kerova vesheenah kerova – tiddache kerova mippene sheenah kerova. hayu shetehen kerovot, shetehen rechokot – hatel peshara benehen, umealot sachar zo lazo.
Tanu rabbanan: "tzedek tzedek tirdof" – hallech achar bet din yafe, achar rabbi eliezer lelod, achar rabban yochanan ben zakkay livrur chayil.
Tana: kol rechayim bevureni – shevua habben, shevua habben. or hanner bivrur chayil – mishte sham, mishte sham.

Tanu rabbanan: "tzedek tzedek tirdof" – hallech achar chachamim lishiva. achar rabbi eliezer lelod, achar rabban yochanan ben zakkay livrur chayil, achar rabbi yehoshua lifkiin, achar rabban gamliel leyavne, achar rabbi akiva livne verak, achar rabbi matya leromi, achar rabbi chananya ben teradyon lesichni, achar rabbi yose letzippori, achar rabbi yehuda ben betira lintzivin, achar rabbi yehoshua laggola, achar rabbi levet shearim, achar chachamim lelishkat haggazit.
Dine mamonot potchin kulei. hechi amrinan? amar rav yehuda: hachi amrinan lehu: mi yemar kidkaamritu?
Amar leh ulla: veha chasminan lehu? velichasmu! mi la tanya: rabbi shimon ben eliezer omer, massiin et haedim mimmakom lemakom kede shettittaref datan veyachzeru bahen?
Mi dame? hatam mimmela ka middechu, hacha ka dachenan lehu beyadayim.
Ella amar ulla: hachi amrinan, "yesh lecha edim lahazimmam?" amar leh rabba: vechi potchin bizchuto shel ze shehi chovato shel ze?
Umi havya chovato? vehatnan: en edim zommin neheragin ad sheyyiggamer haddin.
Hachi amena: illu shatek hay ad demigmar dineh, umayyti edim umazzem lehu, havya leh chovato shel ze. ella amar rabba: amrinan leh, "yesh lecha edim lehachechishan?"
Rav kahana amar: "middivrechem nizdakka peloni". abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: amrinan leh, "i la ketalt la tidchal". rav ashe amar: "kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav".
Tanya kevavteh deabbaye verava. rabbi omer: "im lo shachav ish otach veim lo satit vegomer" –

a: Mikkan sheppotchin bedine nefashot techilla lizchut.
Dine mamonot machazirin kulei. ureminhu: dan et haddin, zikka et hachayyayv, chiyyev et hazzakkay, timme et hattahor, tiher et hattame – ma sheasa asuy, vishallem mibbeto.
Amar rav yosef: la kashya, kan bemumeche, kan besheeno mumeche. uvemumeche machzirin? vehakatane: im haya mumeche levet din – patur milleshallem!
Amar rav nachman: kan sheyyesh gadol hemennu bechachma uveminyan, kan sheen gadol hemennu bechachma uveminyan.
Rav sheshet amar: kan shettaa bidvar mishna, kan shettaa beshikkul haddaat. deamar rav sheshet amar rav assi: taa bidvar mishna – chozer, taa beshikkul haddaat – eno chozer.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: afillu taa berabbi chiyyay verabbi oshaya? amar leh: in. afillu bidrav ushemuel? amar leh: in. afillu bedidi vedidach? amar leh: attu anan katle kene beagma anan?

Hechi dame shikkul haddaat? amar rav pappa: kegon tere tannae o tere amorae difligi ahadade, vela ittemar hilcheta la kemar vela kemar, veikkeri vaavad kechad minnayyhu, vesugeya dishmata azli keiddach – hayeynu shikkul haddaat.
Etiveh rav hamenuna lerav sheshet: maase befara shel bet menachem shennittela haem shellah, veheechilah rabbi tarfon lichlavim.

Uva maase lifne chachamim beyavne, vehittiruha. sheamar todos harofe: en para vachazira yotzet mealekkesanderiyya shel mitzrayim ella im ken chotchin haem shellah, kede shello teled. amar rabbi tarfon: halcha chamorcha, tarfon! amar lo rabbi akiva: patur atta, shekkol hammumeche larabbim patur milleshallem.
Vei ita, lema leh: toe bidvar mishna atta, vetoe bidvar mishna chozer.
Chada veod kaamar: chada, detoe bidvar mishna atta, vetoe bidvar mishna chozer. veod: i name beshikkul haddaat taita – mumeche larabbim atta, vechol hammumeche larabbim patur milleshallem.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak lerava: may ka motev rav hamenuna lerav sheshet mippara? para hare heechilah lichlavim, veleta detehdar.

Hachi kaamar leh: i amrat bishlama taa bidvar mishna eno chozer, alma kam dina – hayeynu deka mefached rabbi tarfon, vekaamar leh ihu: mumeche levet din atta veatta patur milleshallem. ella i amrat taa bidvar mishna chozer, lema leh: kevan deillu havay para, dinach lav dina vela kelum avadt, hasheta name la kelum avadt.
Rav chisda amar: kan – shennatal venatan bayyad, kan – shello natal venatan bayyad.

Bishlama chiyyev et hazzakkay, kegon shennatal venatan bayyad. ella zikka et hachayyayv, hechi mashkachat la? daamar leh: "patur atta", veha lo natal venatan bayyad! kevan deamar "patur atta", kemo shennatal venatan bayyad dame.

Ella matnitin dekatane: dine mamonot machzirin ben lizchut ben lechova, bishlama lizchut mashkachat la, daamar leh meikkara: "chayyayv atta", velo natal velo natan bayyad. ella lechova hechi mashkachat la? deamar leh: "patur atta"? vehaamrat: kevan deamar leh "patur atta", kemo shennatal venatan bayyad dame!
Chada katane: dine mamonot machzirin lizchut, shehi chova. dichvavta gabbe nefashot: machzirin lizchut,
b: Veen machzirin lechova. machzirin lizchut – zechut geredta, veen machzirin lechova – lizchut shehi chova.
Chovteh deman? ha la kashya, chovteh degoel haddam. mishshum chovteh degoel haddam katlinan leh lehay? veod, may "ben" "ben"? kashya.
Ravina amar: kegon shehaya lo beyado mashkon, unetalo mimmennu.
Timme et hattahor, deagga beh sheretz. tiher et hattame, sheervan ben perotav.
Dine nefashot kulei. tanu rabbanan: minnayin leyotze mibbet din chayyayv, veamar echad "yesh li lelammed alav zechut", minnayin shemmachzirin oto? talmud lomar "naki al taharog".
Uminnayin leyotze mibbet din zakkay, veamar echad: "yesh li lelammed alav chova", minnayin sheen machzirin oto? talmud lomar: "tzaddik al taharog".
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: vechillufa lemesit, dichtiv "lo tachmol velo techasse alav". rav kahana matne mikki harog tahargennu".
Bea minneh rabbi zera merav sheshet: chayyayve galiyyot minnayin? atya "rotzeach" "rotzeach".
Chayyayve malkiyyot minnayin? atya "rasha" "rasha".
Tanya name hachi: chayyayve galiyyot minnayin? atya "rotzeach" "rotzeach". chayyayve malkot minnayin? atya "rasha" "rasha".
Veen machzirin lechova. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shettaa bedavar sheen hatztzaddukin modin bo, aval taa bidvar shehatztzaddukin modin bo – zil keri be rav hu.

Bea minneh rabbi chiyyay bar abba merabbi yochanan: taa benoef venoefet mahu? amar leh: addemokdach yekid, zil kutz karach utzeli. ittemar name, amar rabbi amme amar rabbi yochanan: taa benoef – chozer.
Ella hechi dame en chozrin? amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: kegon shettaa shello kedarkah.
Dine mamonot hakkol kulei. hakkol, vaafillu edim? nema matnitin rabbi yose berabbi yehuda hi, vela rabbanan?
Detanya: "veed echad lo yaane venefesh" – ben lizchut ben lechova. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: one lizchut, veen one lechova.
Amar rav pappa: beechad min hattalmidim, vedivre hakkol.

a: May tama derabbi yose bar yehuda? deamar kera: "ed echad lo yaane venefesh lamut". lamut hu deeno one, aval lizchut one. verabbanan? amar resh lakish: mishshum demichaze kenogea beeduto.

Verabbanan, hay "lamut" may darshi beh? mokmi leh beechad min hattalmidim. kidtanya: amar echad min haedim "yesh li lelammed alav zechut", minnayin sheen shomin lo? talmud lomar: "ed echad lo yaane". minnayin leechad min hattalmidim sheamar "yesh li lelammed alav chova", minnayin sheen shomin lo? talmud lomar: "echad lo yaane venefesh lamut".
Dine nefashot: hamelammed kulei. amar rav: lo shanu ella bishat massa umattan, aval bishat gemar din – melammed zechut chozer umelammed chova.

Metivi: lemochorat mashkimin uvain. hamezakke omer: "ani hamezakke, umezakke ani bimkomi". hamechayyev omer: "ani hamechayyev, umechayyev ani bimkomi". hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut eno yachol lachazor ulelammed chova.
Veha lammochorat gemar din hu, velitamaych, lammochorat massa umattan mi lekka? ki katane bishat massa umattan.
Ta shema: danin ellu keneged ellu, ad sheyyire echad min hamechayyeyvin divre hamezakkin. veim ita, litne name ippecha! tanna azzechut ka mehaddar, achova la ka mehaddar.
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: echad min hattalmidim shezzikka vamet – roin oto keillu chay veomed bimkomo. veammay? nema: illu hava kayyaym, [hava] hadar beh! hasheta miha la hadar beh.
Veha shelachu mittam: ledivre rabbi yose bar chanina, mutza mikkelal rabbenu! "en mutza" ittemar.
Ta shema: shene sofre haddayyaynin omdin lifnehen, echad min hayyamin veechad min hassemol, vechotvin divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyeyvin.
Bishlama divre hamechayyeyvin, limchar chazu tama acharina uvau lemebad halanat din. ella divre hamezakkin, may tama? lav mishshum dei chazu tama acharina lechova, la mashgechinan behu?
Lo, kede shello yomru shenayim taam echad mishshene mikraot. kediva minneh rabbi assi merabbi yochanan: amru shenayim taam echad mishshene mikraot, mahu? amar leh: en monin lahen ella echad.

Menahane mille? amar abbaye: deamar kera "achat dibber elohim shetayim zu shamati ki oz lelohim". mikra echad yotze lechamma teamim, veen taam echad yotze mikkamma mikraot. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "uchefattish yefotzetz sala" – ma pattish ze mitchallek lechamma nitzotzot, af mikra echad yotze lechamma teamim.
Hechi dame taam echad mishshene mikraot? amar rav zevid, keditnan: mizbeach mekaddesh et harauy lo.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: kol harauy laishshim, im ala – lo yered, shenneemar: "haola al mokda". ma ola shehi reuya laishshim, im alta – lo tered, af kol shehu rauy laishshim, im ala – lo yered.

Rabban gamliel omer: kol harauy lammizbeach, im ala – lo yered, shenneemar: "hi haola al mokda al hammizbeach". ma ola shehi reuya legabbe mizbeach – im alta lo tered, af kol shehu rauy lemizbeach – im ala lo yered.
Vetarvayyhu may kamrabbu? pesulin. mar mayyte la mimmokda", umar mayyte la mimmizbeach".
Veha hatam miflag peligi, dekatane sefa: en ben divre rabban gamliel ledivre rabbi yehoshua ella haddam vehannesachim, sherabban gamliel omer: lo yerdu, verabbi yehoshua omer: yerdu.
Ella amar rav pappa: kidtanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: mittoch shenneemar
b: "Kol hannogea bammizbeach yikdash" – shomea ani, ben rauy ben sheeno rauy? talmud lomar: "kevasim" – ma kevasim reuyin, af kol rauy. rabbi akiva omer: "ola" – ma ola reuya, af kol rauy.
Vetarvayyhu may ka memaatu? pesule. mar mayyte la mikkevasim", umar mayyte la meola".
Vehaamar rav adda bar ahava: olat haof pesula ikka benayyhu. man demayyte la mikkevasim" – kevasim in, aval olat haof la. uman demayyte la meola" – afillu olat haof name.
Ella amar rav ashe: kidtanya, "dam yechashev laish hahu dam shafach" – lerabbot et hazzorek, divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: "o zavach" – lerabbot et hazzorek. vetarvayyhu may ka merabbu? zerika. mar mayyte la middam yechashev", umar mayyte la meo zavach".
Vehaamar rabbi avahu: shachat vezarak ikka benayyhu. ledivre rabbi yishmael, eno chayyayv ella achat; ledivre rabbi akiva, chayyayv shetayim.
Ha ittemar ala, amar abbaye: af ledivre rabbi akiva name eno chayyayv ella achat, deamar kera "sham taale olotecha vesham taase". arvinhu rachamana lechullehu asiyyot.
Dine mamonot danin bayyom vechulei. (siman: mishpat, maane, matte.) menahane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar pappa: deamar kera "veshaftu et haam bechol et".
I hachi, techillat din name? kidrava, derava rame: ketiv "veshaftu et haam bechol et", uchetiv "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav". ha ketzad? yom litchillat din, layla ligmar din.
Matnitin dela kerabbi meir, detanya: haya rabbi meir omer, ma talmud lomar "al pihem yihye kol riv vechol naga"? vechi ma inyan rivim etzel negaim?

Ella makkish rivim lingaim: ma negaim bayyom, dichtiv "uveyom heraot bo", af rivim bayyom. uma negaim shello besomin, dichtiv "lechol mare ene hakkohen", af rivim shello besomin. umakkish negaim lerivim: ma rivim shello bikrovim, af negaim shello bikrovim.

I ma rivim bishlosha – af negaim bishlosha? vedin hu: mamono bishlosha, gufo la kol shekken? talmud lomar: "vehuva el aharon hakkohen o el echad vegomer". ha lamadta sheafillu kohen echad roe et hannegaim.

Hahu samya dahava beshivvuteh derabbi yochanan, dahava daen dina, vela amar leh rabbi yochanan vela midde. hechi aved hachi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: kol hakkasher ladun kasher lehaid, veyesh shekkasher lehaid veen kasher ladun. veamar rabbi yochanan: leetoye some beachat meenav.
Rabbi yochanan setama achrita ashkach: dine mamonot danin bayyom, vegomrin ballayla.
May ulemeh dehay setama mehay setama? i baet ema: setama derabbim adif, vei baet ema: mishshum dekatane la gabbe hilcheta dedina.

Verabbi meir, hay "veshaftu et haam bechol et" may daresh beh? amar rava: leetoye yom hameunnan. ditnan: en roin et hannegaim shacharit, uven haarbayim, velo betoch habbayit, velo beyom hameunnan, mippene shekkeha niret azza. velo batztzohorayim, mippene sheazza niret keha.

Verabbi meir, hay "beyom hanechilo et banav" may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh lechidtane rabba bar chanina kammeh derav nachman: "vehaya beyom hanechilo et banav" – bayyom atta mappil nachalot, vei atta mappil nachalot ballayla. amar leh: ella meatta, man deshachev bimama yirtun leh beneh, uman deshachev belelya la yirtun leh beneh?
Dilma din nachalot kaamrat? detanya: "vehayta livne yisrael lechukkat mishpat" – ora kol happarasha kuvllah lihyot din.
Kidrav yehuda amar rav, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: shelosha shennichnesu levakker et hachole, ratzu – kotvin, ratzu – osin din. shenayim – kotvin veen osin din.
Veamar rav chisda: lo shanu ella bayyom, aval ballayla kotvin veen osin din, mishshum dehavu lehu edim, veen ed naase dayyayn. amar leh: in, hachi kaamena.

Dine nefashot danin bayyom vechulei. menahane mille? amar rav shimi bar chiyyay: amar kera, "vehoka otam laAdonai neged hashshamesh". amar rav chisda: minnayin lehokaa shehi teliyyay? dichtiv: "vehokaanum laAdonai begivat shaul bechir Adonai".

a: Uchetiv: "vattikkach ritzpa vat ayya et hassak vattattehu lah el hatztzur bitchillat katzir".
Uchetiv: "vayyomer Adonai el moshe kach et kol rashe haam". im haam chatu, rashe haam ma chatu?

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, challek lahem batte dinin. may tama? illema mishshum sheen danin shenayim beyom echad? vehaamar rav chisda: lo shanu ella bishte mitot, aval bemita achat danin!
Ella, kede sheyyashuv charon af miyyisrael.
Dine mamonot gomrin bo bayyom kulei. menahane mille?
Amar rabbi chanina: deamar kera, "meleati mishpat tzedek yalin bah veatta meratztzechim". verava amar mehacha: "ashsheru chamotz" – ashsheru dayyayn shemmechammetz et dino.
Veiddach: "ashsheru chamotz", velo chometz. veiddach, hay "meleati mishpat" may aved leh?

Kidrabbi elazar amar rabbi yitzchak, deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi yitzchak: kol taanit shemmelinin bo et hatztzedaka – keillu shofech damim, shenneemar: "meleati mishpat tzedek vegomer". vehane mille – berifta vetamre, aval bezuze, chitte useare – let lan ba.
Lefichach en danin kulei. may tama?

Mishshum dela efshar. hechi lebad? lidayyeyneh bemaale shabbeta veligmereh ledineh bemaale shabbeta? dilma chazu taam lechova, uvau lemibad halanat din. ledayyeyneh bemaale shabbeta veligmereh beshabbeta, velikteleh beshabbeta? en retzicha docha et shabbat. velikteleh leureta? neged hashshemesh baenan.

Veligmereh ledineh beshabbeta, velikteleh bechad beshabbeta? nimtza atta meanne et dino. nidayyeyneh bemaale shabbeta venigmereh bechad beshabbeta? minneshu tamayyhu. af al gav dishne sofre haddayyaynin omdim lifnehem, vechotvin divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyeyvin, nehi divfumma katvin, libba deinneshi inneshi. hilkach la efshar.
Amar leh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: utehe kevurat met mitzva docha shabbat mikkal vachomer: uma avoda sheddocha shabbat – kevurat met mitzva docha otah, miuleachoto".
Kidtanya: "leaviv uleimmo leachiv uleachoto" – ma talmud lomar? hare shehaya holech lishchot et pischo velamul et beno
b: Veshama shemmet lo met, yachol yittamme? amarta: "lo yittamme".
Yachol, keshem sheeno mittamme laachoto kach eno mittamme lemet mitzva? talmud lomar: "uleachoto". laachoto hu deeno mittamme, aval mittamme lemet mitzva.
Shabbat shennidchet mippene avoda, eno din shettehe kevurat met mitzva docha otah?
Amar leh: retzicha tochiach, sheddocha et haavoda veenah docha et hashshabbat.

Retzicha gufah tidche et hashshabbat mikkal vachomer: ma avoda sheddoche et hashshabbat, retzicha docha otah, shenneemar "meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut"; shabbat shennidchet mippene avoda, eno din shettehe retzicha docha otah?
Amar rava: kevar paska tana deve rabbi yishmael, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "lo tevaaru esh" – ma talmud lomar?
Ma talmud lomar? i lerabbi yose – lelav yatzat, i lerabbi natan – lechallek yatzat. kidtanya: haveara lelav yatzat, divre rabbi yose. rabbi natan omer: lechallek yatzat.

Ella amar rava: tena "moshavot" kashya leh. "moshavot" – ma talmud lomar? mikkede shabbat chovat hagguf hi, vechovat hagguf noheget ben bearetz ben bechutz laaretz. "moshavot" dichtav rachamana lema li?

Mishshum rabbi yishmael amar talmid echad: lefi shenneemar "ki yihye veish chet mishpat mavet vehumat", shomea ani ben bachol ben bashshabbat. veha ma ani mekayyem "mechalleleha mot yumat"? bishar melachot, chutz mimmitat bet din. o eno ella afillu mitat bet din? uma ani mekayyem "vehumat"? bechol aval lo beshabbat. o eno ella afillu bashshabbat?

Talmud lomar: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem", ulehallan hu omer: "vehayu elle lachem lechukkat mishpat ledorotechem bechol moshvotechem". ma "moshavot" haamur lehallan – bet din, af "moshavot" haamur kan – bet din. veamar rachamana: "lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem".

Amar abbaye: hasheta deamrat en retzicha docha et hashshabbat, en retzicha docha et haavoda mikkal vachomer. uma shabbat shennidchet mippene haavoda – en retzicha docha otah, avoda shehi docha et hashshabbat – eno din shello tehe retzicha docha otah?
Ella, ha dichtiv: "meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut"? hahu lekorban yachid, dela dache shabbat.
Amar rava: i hachi, la tehe retzicha docha korban yachid mikkal vachomer:

a: Ma yom tov shennidche mippene korban yachid, en retzicha docha oto. korban yachid shehu doche et yom tov, eno din shello tehe retzicha docha oto?
Hanicha leman deamar en nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov, ella leman deamar nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov – may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rava: la mibbaya leman deamar nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov, deha la mitkayyem "meim mizbechi" kelal.
Ella afillu leman deamar: nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov, hachtiv "meim mizbechi" – mizbechi hameyuchad li, umay ninhu? tamid. veamar rachamana: "meim mizbechi tikkachennu lamut".
Dine mamonot, hattemaot vehatteharot kulei. amar rav: ana havay beminyana deve rabbi, uminnay didi havo matchali beresha. veha anan "matchilin min haggadol" tenan!
Amar rabba bereh derava, veittema rabbi hillel bereh derabbi vavles: shane minyayna deve rabbi, dechullehu minyanayyhu min hatztzad havo matchali.
Veamar rabba bereh derava, veittema rabbi hillel bereh derabbi vavles: mimot moshe vead rabbi lo matzinu tora ugedulla bemakom echad.
Vela? ha hava yehoshua! hava elazar. veha hava pinchas! havo zekenim.
Veha hava shaul! hava shemuel. veha nach nafsheh! kullehu sheneh kaamrinan.
Veha hava david! hava ira hayyairi. veha nach nafsheh! kullehu sheneh kaamrinan.
Veha hava shelomo! hava shimi ben gera. veha katleh! kulleh sheneh kaamrinan.
Ha hava chizkiyya! hava shevna. veha ikketil! kullehu sheneh kaamrinan. veha hava ezra! hava nechemya ben chachalya.
Amar rav adda bar ahava: af ani omer, mimot rabbi ad rav ashe lo matzinu tora ugedulla bemakom echad. vela? veha hava huna bar natan! huna bar natan mikkaf hava kayif leh lerav ashe.
Dine nefashot matchilin min hatztzad. mena hane mille? amar rav acha bar pappa: amar kera, "lo taane al riv". lo taane al rav.
Rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, mehacha: "vayyomer david laanashav chigru ish [et] charbo vayyachgeru ish [et] charbo vayyachgor gam david et charbo".

Amar rav: shone adam letalmido, vedan immo bedine nefashot. metivi: hatteharot vehattemaot, haav uveno, harav vetalmido – monin lahem shenayim. dine mamonot vedine nefashot vedine makkot, kiddush hachodesh veibbur shana – av uveno, harav vetalmido, en monin lahen ella echad.
b: Ki kaamar rav, kegon rav kahana verav assi, deligmareh derav havo tzerichi, velisvareh derav la havo tzerichi.
Amar rabbi avahu: asara devarim yesh ben dine mamonot ledine nefashot, vechullan en nohagin beshor hanniskal, chutz meesrim ushelosha.
Mena hane mille? amar rav acha bar pappa: deamar kera "lo tatte mishpat evyoncha berivo". mishpat evyoncha i atta matte, aval atta matte mishpat shel shor hanniskal.
Asara? ha tisha havu! ha asara katane! mishshum deen hakkol kesherin, veesrim ushelosha – chada hi.
Ha ikka achariti, detanya: en moshivin besanhedrin zaken vesaris umi sheen lo banim. rabbi yehuda mosif: af achzari. vechillufehen bemesit, derachamana amar: "lo tachmol velo techasse alav".
Hakkol kesherin ladun dine mamonot. hakkol leetoye may? amar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer.

Ha tenena chada zimna: kol harauy ladun dine nefashot rauy ladun dine mamonot, veyesh rauy ladun dine mamonot veen rauy ladun dine nefashot. vehavenan ba: leetoye may? veamar rav yehuda: leetoye mamzer. chada leetoye ger, vachada leetoye mamzer.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan ger – derauy lavo bakkahal, aval mamzer ema la. vei ashmeinan mamzer – deva mittippa keshera, aval ger delo ba mittippa keshera ema la. tzericha.
Veen hakkol kesherin ladun dine nefashot. may tama? detane rav yosef: keshem shebbet din menukkin betzedek, kach menukkin mikkol mum. amar ammemar, may kera: "kullach yafa rayati umum en bach".
Vedilma mum mammash? amar rav acha bar yaakov: amar kera, "vehityatztzevu sham immach" – immach bedomin lach.
Vedilma hatam mishshum shechina? ella, amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: amar kera "venasu ittach" – ittach bedomin lach leheve.

Mishna sanhedrin hayta kachatzi goren agulla, kede sheyyehu roin ze et ze. ushene sofre haddayyaynin omdim lifnehem, echad miyyamin veechad missemol, vechotvin divre mechayyeyvin vedivre mezakkin. rabbi yehuda omer: shelosha, echad kotev divre hamezakkin, veechad kotev divre hamechayyeyvin, vehashshelishi kotev divre hamezakkin vedivre hamechayyeyvin.

a: Veshalosh shurot shel talmide chachamim yoshvin lifnehen, kol echad veechad makkir et mekomo. hutzerchu lismoch – somchin min harishona. echad min hashsheniyya ba lo larishona, echad min hashshelishit ba lo lashsheniyya. borrim lahen od echad min hakkahal umoshivin oto bashshelishit. velo haya yoshev bimkomo shel rishon, ella yoshev bemakom harauy lo.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi acha bar chanina: deamar kera "shorrech aggan hassahar al yechsar hammazeg vegomer".
"Shorrech" – zo sanhedrin. lamma nikra shemah "shorrech"? shehi yoshevet betibburo shel olam. "aggan" – shehi meginna al kol haolam kullo. "hassahar" – shehi doma lassahar.
"Al yechsar hammazeg" – sheim hutzerach echad mehem latzet, roin: im yesh esrim ushelosha, keneged sanhedri ketanna – yotze, veim lav – eno yotze.
"Bitnecha aremat chittim" – ma aremat chittim hakkol nehenin mimmenna, af sanhedrin hakkol nehenin mittaamehen. "suga bashshoshannim" – sheafillu kesuga shel shoshannim lo yifretzu bahen peratzot.

Vehayeynu daamar leh hahu mina lerav kahana: amritu nidda shere leyaychode bahade gavra. efshar esh binoret veenah mehavehevet? amar leh: hattora heida alenu "suga bashshoshannim", sheafillu kesuga bashshoshannim lo yifretzu bahen peratzot.
Resh lakish amar: mehacha, "kefelach harimmon rakkatech" – afillu rekanin shebbach melein mitzvot kerimmon. rabbi zera amar: mehacha, "vayyarach et reach begadav". al tikre "begadav" ella "bogdav".

Hanhu biryone dahavo beshivavuteh derabbi zera, dahava mekarev lehu ki hechi denehderu lehu bityuveta, vahavo kafdi rabbanan. ki nach nafsheh derabbi zera, amri: ad haiddana hava charicha kattin shakeh dahava bae alan rachame, hasheta man bae alan rachame? hareharu belibbayyhu vaavadu teshuva.

Shalosh shurot kulei. amar abbaye: shema minna ki nayydi, kullehu nayydi. velema lehu: ad haiddana hava yatevna beresha, hasheta motvitu li bedanve? amar abbaye: deamri leh hachi, "heve zanav laarayot veal tehi rosh lashshualim".

Mishna ketzad meayyeymin et haedim al ede nefashot? hayu machnisin otan umeayyeymin alehen: shemma tomru meomed umishshemua, ed mippi ed umippi adam neeman, shemma i attem yodin shessofenu livdok etchem bidrisha uvachakira.
Hevu yodin, shello kedine mamonot dine nefashot. dine mamonot – adam noten mamon umitkapper lo. dine nefashot – damo vedam zariyyotav teluyin bo ad sof haolam.

Shekken matzinu bekayin sheharag et achiv, shenneemar: "deme achicha tzoakim". eno omer "dam achicha" ella "deme achicha" – damo vedam zariyyotav. davar acher: "deme achicha" – shehaya damo mushelach al haetzim veal haavanim.

Lefichach nivra adam yechidi, lelammedcha shekkol hameabbed nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu ibbed olam male. vechol hamekayyem nefesh achat miyyisrael, maale alav hakkatuv keillu kiyyem olam male.
Umippene shelom habberiyyot, shello yomar adam lachavero: "abba gadol meavicha", veshello yehu hamminim omrim: "harebe reshuyot bashshamayim".

Ulehaggid gedullato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, sheadam tovea kamma matbeot bechotam echad – kullan domin ze laze, umelech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu tava kol adam bechotamo shel adam harishon, veen echad mehen dome lachavero. lefichach kol echad veechad chayyayv lomar: bishvili nivra haolam.
Veshemma tomru:
b: Ma lanu velatztzara hazzot? vahalo kevar neemar: "vehu ed o raa o yada im lo yaggid vegomer". veshemma tomru: ma lanu lachuv bedamo shel ze? vahalo kevar neemar: "baavod reshaim rinna".

Gemara tanu rabbanan: ketzad meomed? omer lahen: shemma kach reitem? sheratz achar chavero lechureba, veratztem acharav, umetzatem sayif beyado vedamo metaftef, veharug mefarper. im kach reitem – lo reitem kelum.

Tanya, amar rabbi shimon ben shatach: ere benechama im lo raiti echad sheratz achar chavero lechureba, veratzti acharav veraiti sayif beyado vedamo metaftef veharug mefarper. veamarti lo: rasha, mi harago laze? o ani o atta. aval ma eese sheen damcha masur beyadi, shehare amra tora "al pi shenayim edim yumat hammet". hayyodea machshavot yippara meoto haish sheharag et chavero. amru: lo zazu mishsham ad shebba nachash vehikkisho vamet.

Vehay bar nachash hu? vehaamar rav yosef, vechen tane deve chizkiyya: miyyom shecharav bet hammikdash, af al pi shebbatla sanhedri, arba mitot lo batlu. lo batlu? veha batlu! ella, din arba mitot lo batlu.

Mi shennitchayyev sekila – o nofel min haggag, o chayya dorasto. mi shennitchayyev serefa – o nofel bidleka, o nachash makkisho. mi shennitchayyev hariga – o nimsar lammalchut, o listin bain alav. mi shennitchayyev chenek – o tovea bannahar, o met bisronche.
Amri: hahu chet achariti hava beh, deamar mar: mi shennitchayyev shete mitot bet din – niddon bachamura.

Meomed vechulei. bedine nefashot hu dela amdinan, ha bedine mamonot amdinan. keman? kerabbi acha, detanya, rabbi acha omer: gamal haocher ben haggemallim venimtza gamal harug betziddo – beyadua shezze harago.

Velitamaych, ed mippi ed dekatane bedine nefashot hu dela amrinan, ha bedine mamonot amrinan? vehatnan: im amar "hu amar li sheani chayyayv lo", "ish peloni amar li shehu chayyayv lo" – lo amar kelum, ad sheyyomar "befanenu hoda lo shehu chayyayv lo matayim zuz".
Alma, af al gav difsili bedine mamonot, amrinan lehu bedine nefashot. hacha name, af al gav difsili bedine mamonot, amrinan lehu bedine nefashot.
Hevu yodim kulei. amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: melammed sheasa kayin behevel achiv chabburot chabburot, petziot petziot, shello haya yodea mehechan neshama yotza, ad shehiggia letzavvaro.

Veamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: miyyom sheppatcha haaretz et piha vekibbelattu ledamo shel hevel, shuv lo patcha, shenneemar: "mikkenaf haaretz zemirot shamanu tzevi latztzaddik" – mikkenaf haaretz velo mippi haaretz. etiveh chizkiyya achiv: "vattiftach haaretz et piha"! amar leh: leraa patcha, letova lo patcha.
Veamar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: galut mechapperet avon mechetza. meikkara ketiv: "vehayiti na venad", ulevassof ketiv: "vayyeshev beeretz nod".

Amar rav yehuda: galut mechapperet shelosha devarim, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai vegomer hayyoshev bair hazzot yamut bacherev baraav uvaddaver vehayyotze venafal al hakkasdim hatztzarim alechem vechaya vehayta lo nafsho leshalal".

Rabbi yochanan amar: galut mechapperet al hakkol, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai kitvu et haish hazze ariri gever lo yitzlach beyamav ki lo yitzlach mizzaro ish yoshev al kisse david umoshel od bihuda". uvatar digla ketiv: "uvene yechanya assir (beno) shaltiel beno". assir – sheibberattu immo bevet haasurin. shaltiel – sheshshetalo el shello kederech hannishtalin: gemiri sheen haishsha mitabberet meummad,

a: Vehi nitabbera meummad. davar acher: shaltiel – shennishal al alato el. zerubbavel – shennizra bevavel. uma shemo? nechemya ben chachalya shemo.

Yehuda vechizkiyya bene rabbi chiyyay havo yatvi bisudeta kamme rabbi, vela havo ka amri vela midde. amar lehu: agbaru chamra addardeke ki hechi delemru milleta. kevan deibbassum, patchu vaamaru: en ben david ba ad sheyyichlu shene batte avot miyyisrael, veellu hen: rosh gola shebbevavel venasi shebbeeretz yisrael, shenneemar: "vehaya lemikdash uleeven negef uletzur michshol lishne vatte yisrael".
Amar lahem: banayy, kotzim attem metilin li beenayy? amar lo rabbi chiyyay: rabbi, al yera beenecha. "yayin" nittan beshivim otiyyot, vesod" nittan beshivim otiyyot. nichnas yayin – yatza sod.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva, veamri la amar rav chisda: daresh mari bar mar, may dichtiv: "vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayvieha alenu ki tzaddik Adonai elohenu"? mishshum detzaddik Adonai – "vayyishkod Adonai al haraa vayvieha alenu"? in, tzedaka asa hakkadosh baruch hu im yisrael shehikdim galut tzidkiyyahu veod galut yechonya kayyemet.
Dichtiv beh begalut yechonya: "hecharash vehammasger elef". charash – kevan sheppotchin, hakkol naasu kechershin. masger – kevan shessogrin bahalacha, shuv en potchin. vechamma hayu? elef.
Ulla amar: shehikdim shete shanim livnoshantem".
Amar rav acha bar yaakov: shema minna, "mehera" demare alma tamne mea vechamshin vetarten havu.

Lefichach kulei. tanu rabbanan: adam yechidi nivra, umippene ma? shello yehu minim omrin "harebe reshuyot bashshamayim". davar acher: mippene hatztzaddikim umippene harshaim, shello yehu hatztzaddikim omrim "anu bene tzaddik", ureshaim omrim "anu bene rasha".

Davar acher: mippene hammishpachot, shello yehu mishpachot mitgarot zo bazo. uma achshav shennivra yachid mitgarot, nivreu shenayim – al achat kamma vechamma! davar acher: mippene haggazlanin umippene hachamsanin. uma achshav shennivra yechidi gozlin vechomsin, nivreu shenayim – al achat kamma vechamma!

Ulehaggid gedullato kulei. tanu rabbanan, lehaggid gedullato shel melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu, sheadam tovea kamma matbeot bechotam echad vechullan domin ze leze, aval hakkadosh baruch hu tovea kol adam bechotamo shel adam harishon veen echad mehen dome lachavero, shenneemar: "tithappech kechomer chotam veyityatztzevu kemo levush".
Umippene ma en partzufehen domin ze laze? shello yire adam dira naa veishsha naa veyomar: "shelli hi". shenneemar: "veyimmana mershaim oram uzeroa rama tishshaver".
Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: bishlosha devarim adam mishtanne mechavero: bekol, bemare, uvedaat. bekol uvemare – mishshum erva, uvedaat – mippene haggazlanin vehachamsanin.

Tanu rabbanan: adam nivra beerev shabbat, umippene ma? shello yehu minim omrim: shuttaf haya lo lehakkadosh baruch hu bemaase vereshit. davar acher: sheim tazuach dato alav, omer lo: yattush kedamcha bemaase vereshit. davar acher: kede sheyyikkanes lammitzva miyyad.

Davar acher: kede sheyyikkanes lasseuda miyyad. mashal lemelech basar vadam shebbenah palterin veshichlelan, vehitkin seuda, veachar kach hichnis orchin. shenneemar: "chochmot banta vetah chatzva ammudeha shiva. tavcha tivchah mascha yenah af archa shulchanah. shalcha naaroteha tikra al gappe merome karet."

"Chochmot banta vetah" – zo middato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, shebbara et kol haolam kullo bechochma. "chatzva ammudeha shiva" – ellu shivat yeme bereshit. "tavcha tivchah mascha yenah af archa shulchanah" – ellu yammim uneharot vechol tzorche olam. "shalcha naaroteha tikra" – ze adam vechavva.
"Al gappe merome karet" – rabba bar bar chana rame: ketiv "al gappe", uchetiv "al kisse". battechilla – al gappe, ulevassof – al kisse.
"Mi feti yasur henna chasar lev amra lo". amar hakkadosh baruch hu: mi pittahu laze? ishsha amra lo. dichtiv: "noef ishsha chasar lev".

Tanya, haya rabbi meir omer: adam harishon mikkol haolam kullo hutzebar afaro, shenneemar: "golmi rau enecha", uchetiv: "ki Adonai enav meshottot bechol haaretz". amar rav oshaya mishshemeh derav: adam harishon
b: Gufo mibbavel, verosho meeretz yisrael, veevarav mishshear aratzot. agvotav, amar rav acha: meakra deagma.

Amar rabbi yochanan bar chanina: shetem esre shaot have hayyom. shaa rishona – hutzebar afaro, sheniyya – naasa golem, shelishit – nimtechu evarav, reviit – nizreka bo neshama, chamishit – amad al raglav, shishshit – kara shemot, sheviit – nizdavvevga lo chavva, sheminit – alu lammitta shenayim veyardu arbaa, teshiit – nitztavvav shello leechol min hailan, asirit – sarach, achat esre – niddon, shetem esre – nitrad vehalach lo, shenneemar: "adam bikar bal yalin".
Amar rame bar chama: en chayya raa sholetet beadam ella im ken nidma lo kivhema, shenneemar: "nimshal kabbehemot nidmu".

(Shaa, bassof, arammi – siman.) amar rav yehuda amar rav: beshaa shebbikkesh hakkadosh baruch hu livroot et haadam, bara kat achat shel malache hashsharet. amar lahem: retzonchem naase adam betzalmenu? amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, ma maasav? amar lahen: kach vechach maasav.

Amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, "ma enosh ki tizkerennu uven adam ki tifkedennu"? hoshit etzbao ketanna benehen userafam. vechen kat sheniyya. kat shelishit amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, rishonim sheamru lefanecha ma hoilu? kol haolam kullo shellecha hu. kol ma sheatta rotze laasot beolamcha – ase.

Kevan shehiggia leanshe dor hammabbul veanshe dor happelagga shemmaasehen mekulekalin, amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, lo yafe amru rishonim lefanecha? amar lahen: "vead zikna ani hu vead seva ani esbol vegomer".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: adam harishon missof haolam vead sofo haya, shenneemar: "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim". kevan shessarach, hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yado alav umiato, shenneemar: "achor vakedem tzartani vattashet alay kappecha".

Amar rabbi elazar: adam harishon min haaretz ad larakia haya, shenneemar: "lemin hayyom asher bara elohim adam al haaretz ulemiktze hashshamayim ad ketze hashshamayim". kevan shessarach, hinniach hakkadosh baruch hu yado alav umiato, shenneemar: "achor vakedem tzartani vegomer". kashu kerae ahadade? idde veidde chada midda hi.
Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: adam harishon belashon arammi sipper, shenneemar: "veli ma yakru reecha el".

Vehayeynu deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "ze sefer toldot adam"? melammed sheherahu hakkadosh baruch hu dor dor vedorshav, dor dor vachachamav. kevan shehiggia ledoro shel rabbi akiva, samach betorato venitatztzev bemitato. amar: "veli ma yakru reecha el".

Veamar rav yehuda amar rav: adam harishon min haya, shenneemar: "vayyikra Adonai elohim el haadam vayyomer lo ayyekka" – an nata libbecha? rabbi yitzchak amar: moshech beorlato haya. ketiv hacha: "vehemma keadam avru verit", uchetiv hatam: "et beriti hefar".
Rav nachman amar: kofer baikkar haya. ketiv hacha: "avru verit", uchetiv hatam: "et beriti hefar", veamru: "al asher azvu et berit Adonai elohe avotam".
Tenan hatam, rabbi eliezer omer: heve shakud lilmod tora, veda ma shettashiv laeppikoros. amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella eppikoros nochri, aval eppikoros yisrael – kol shekken defakar tefe.

Amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheppakru hamminim, teshuvatan betziddan. "naase adam betzalmenu", veomer: "vayyivra elohim et haadam betzalmo". "hava nerda venavla sham sefatam" – "vayyered Adonai lirot et hair veet hammigdal". "ki sham niglu elav haelohim" – "lael haone oti beyom tzarati".

"Ki mi goy gadol asher lo elohim kerovim elav chaAdonai elohenu bechol korenu elav". "umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz asher halchu elohim lifdot lo leam". "ad di chorsavan remiv, veattik yomin yetiv".
Hanach lema li? kidrabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: en hakkadosh baruch hu ose davar ella im ken nimlach befamalya shel mala, shenneemar "bigzerat irin pitgama uvememar kaddishin sheelta".

Hatinach kullehi, "ad di chorsavan remiv" may ikka lememar? echad lo veechad ledavid, detanya: echad lo veechad ledavid, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yose: akiva, ad matay atta ose shechina chol? ella echad ledin veechad litzdaka.

Kabbela minneh o la kabbela minneh? ta shema, detanya: echad ledin veechad litzdaka, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi elazar ben azarya: akiva, ma lecha etzel haggada? kelach etzel negaim veohalot! ella, echad lechisse veechad lishrafraf: kisse leshev alav, sherafraf lahadom raglav.

Amar rav nachman: hay man deyada leahdore lemine kerav idit – layhdar, vei la – la layhdar. amar hahu mina lerav idit, ketiv: "veel moshe amar ale el Adonai". "ale elay" mibbee leh! amar leh: zehu metatron sheshshemo keshem rabbo, dichtiv "ki shemi bekirbo".

I hachi, niflechu leh! ketiv: "al tammer bo" – al temireni bo. im ken, "lo yissa lefishachem" lema li? amar leh: hemanuta bidan, daafillu befarvavnka name la kabbelneh, dichtiv: "vayyomer elav im en panecha holchim vegomer".

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi yishmael berabbi yose: ketiv "vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gofrit vaesh meet Adonai", "meitto" mibbee leh! amar leh hahu koves: shivkeh, ana mahdarna leh. dichtiv "vayyomer lemech lenashav ada vetzilla shemaan koli neshe lemech", nashayy mibbee leh! ella mishtae kera hachi, hacha name mishtae kera hachi. amar leh: mena lach ha? mippirkeh derabbi meir shemia li.

Deamar rabbi yochanan: ki hava daresh rabbi meir befirkeh, hava daresh tilta shemata, tilta aggadta, tilta matle. veamar rabbi yochanan: shalosh meot mishlot shualim hayu lo lerabbi meir, veanu en lanu ella shalosh.

a: "Avot yochlu voser veshinne vanim tikhena", "mozne tzedek avne tzedek", "tzaddik mitztzara nechelatz vayyavo rasha tachtav".

Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: elohechem gannav hu, dichtiv: "vayyappel Adonai elohim tardema al haadam vayyishan". amara leh beratte: shivkeh, daana mahdarna leh. amara leh: tenu li dukkos echad. amar la: lema lich? listin bau alenu hallayla venatlu mimmennu kiton shel kesef vehinnichu lanu kiton shel zahav. amar lah: ulevavy sheyyavou alenu bechol yom. velo yafe haya lo leadam harishon, shennatlu mimmennu tzela achat venatnu lo shifcha leshammesho?

Amar la: hachi kaamena, ella lishkelay behedya? amara leh: ayyto li umetza devisra. ayyto la. otva tute bachsha, appikta. amara leh: echol (mehay). amar la: meisa li. amara leh: veadam harishon name, i havat shekila behedya, hava meisa leh.

Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: yadana elahayychu may ka aved vehechan yatev. itnegid veittenach. amar leh: may hay? amar leh: ben echad yesh li bichrakke hayyam veyesh li giaguim alav. baena demachvet leh nihali. amar: mi yadana hecha nihu? amar leh: deikka beara la yadat, deikka bishmayya yadat?

Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: ketiv "mone mispar lakkochavim", may revuteh? ana matzena lemimne kochve! ayyti chavushe, shedinhu bearbela, veka mehaddar lehu. amar leh: meninhu. amar leh: okminhu! amar leh: rakia name hachi hadra.
Ikka deamri, hachi amar leh: meni li kochve. amar leh: ema li kakkaych veshinnaych kamma have? sheda yedeh lefummeh veka mane lehu. amar leh: deikka befummaych la yadat, deikka birkia yadat?

Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: mi shebbara harim lo bara ruach, shenneemar "ki hinne yotzer harim uvore ruach". ella meatta, gabbe adam dichtiv "vayyivra" "vayyitzer", hachi name mi shebbara ze lo bara ze?

Tefach al tefach yesh bo baadam, ushene nekavim yesh bo. mi shebbara ze lo bara ze? shenneemar: "hanota ozen halo yishma veim yotzer ayin halo yabbit". amar leh: in. amar leh: uvishat mita kullan nitpayyeysu?
Amar leh hahu amgusha leammemar: mippalgach leillay dehormiz, mippalgach letattay deahormiz. amar leh: im ken, hechi shavek leh ahormiz lehormiz leabbore mayya beareh?

Amar leh kesar lerabbi tanchum: ta lihvo kullan leamma chad. amar: lechayye, anan demahalinan la matzenan mihve kevavtayychu. attun mahalitu vehevo kevavtan! amar leh: memar shappir kaamrat, mihu kol dezache lemalka lishdeyu levevar. shadyu levevar vela achlu. amar leh hahu mina: hay dela achlu mishshum dela kefun hu. shadyu leh ledideh veachlu.

Amar leh kesar lerabban gamliel: amritu kol be asra shechinta sharya, kamma shechinta ikka? karyeh leshammaeh, mecha beh beappatka. amar leh: ammay al shimsha beveteh dekesar? amar leh: shimsha akkulle alma naycha. uma shimsha dechad min elef alfe ribbo shammashe dekamme kudesha berich hu naycha akkulle alma, shechinta dekudesha berich hu al achat kamma vechamma.

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu: elohechem gachachan hu, dekaamar leh lichezkel "shechav al tziddecha hassemali", uchetiv "veshachavta al tziddecha hayemani"! ata hahu talmida, amar leh: may tama dishviata? amar lehu: hasheta amena lechu milleta deshavya letarvayychu.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael: ziru shesh vehashemitu sheva, kede shettedu shehaaretz shelli hi. vehen lo asu ken, ella chatu vegalu. minhago shel olam: melech basar vadam shessarcha alav medina – im achzari hu, horeg et kullan; im rachman hu, horeg chetzyam; im rachman male rachamim hu, meyaysser haggedolim shebbahen beyissurin. af kach hakkadosh baruch hu meyaysser et yechezkel kede lemarek avonotehem shel yisrael.
Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avahu: elohechem kohen hu, dichtiv "veyikchu li teruma". ki kavreh lemoshe, bemay tevel? vechi tema bemayya, vehachtiv "mi madad beshoolo mayim"?
Amar leh: benura tevel, dichtiv "ki hinne Adonai baesh yavo". umi salka teviluta benura? amar leh: adderabba, ikkar teviluta benura hu, dichtiv "vechol asher lo yavo baesh taaviru vammayim".

Amar leh hahu mina lerabbi avina: ketiv "umi cheammecha keyisrael goy echad baaretz", may revutayyhu? attun name arvitu bahadan, dichtiv "kol haggoyim keayin negdo". amar leh: middidchu ashidu alan, dichtiv
b: "Uvaggoyim lo yitchashshav".
Rabbi elazar rame: ketiv "tov Adonai lakkol", uchetiv "tov Adonai lekovavyv". mashal leadam sheyyesh lo pardes: keshehu mashke – mashke et kullo, keshehu oder – eno oder ella tovim shebbahem.
Lefichach kol echad veechad kulei. "vayyaavor harinna bammachane". amar rabbi acha bar chanina: "baavod reshaim rinna" – baavod achav ben amri rinna.

Umi chade kudesha berich hu bemappaltan shel reshaim? hachtiv: "betzet lifne hechalutz veomrim hodu laAdonai ki leolam chasdo". veamar rabbi yonatan: mippene ma lo neemar behodaa zo "ki tov"? lefi sheen hakkadosh baruch hu sameach bemappaltan shel reshaim.

Deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan: may dichtiv "velo karav ze el ze kol hallayla"? beotah shaa bikkeshu malache hashsharet lomar shira lifne hakkadosh baruch hu. amar lahen hakkadosh baruch hu: maase yaday tovin bayyam veattem omrim shira lefanay?
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: hu eno sas, aval acherim mesis. dayka name, dichtiv "yasis" vela ketiv "yasus". shema minna.

"Vehazzonot rachatzu vegomer", amar rabbi elazar: lemarek shete chezyonot, achat shel michayhu veachat shel eliyyahu. bemichayhu ketiv: "im shov tashuv beshalom lo dibber Adonai bi"; beeliyyahu ketiv: "bimkom asher lakku hakkelavim et dam navot".
Rava amar: zonot mammash. achav ish metzunnan haya, veasta lo izevel shete tzure zonot bemerkavto, kede sheyyire otan veyitchammem.
"Veish mashach bakkeshet letummo vayyakke". rabbi elazar amar: lefi tummo. rava amar: letammem shete chezyonot, achat shel michayhu veachat shel eliyyahu.
(Siman: kara, vezacha, beedom.) ketiv: "vayyikra achav el ovadyahu asher al habbayit veovadyahu haya yare [et] Adonai meod". may kaamar kera?

Amar rabbi yitzchak: amar leh, beyaakov ketiv "nichashti vayvarcheni Adonai biglalecha", beyosef ketiv "vayvarech Adonai et bet hammitzri biglal yosef". beta dehahu gavra la hava mibberich. shemma lo yere elohim atta? yatzta bat kol veamra: "veovadyahu haya yare et Adonai meod", aval beto shel achav eno mezumman livracha.
Amar rabbi abba: gadol shenneemar beovadyahu yoter mimma shenneemar beavraham, deillu beavraham la ketiv "meod", uveovadyahu ketiv "meod".

Amar rabbi yitzchak: mippene ma zacha ovadyahu linviut? mippene shehechbi mea neviim bammeara, shenneemar: "vayhi behacherit izevel et nevie Adonai vayyikkach ovadyahu mea neviim vayyachbiem chamishshim ish bammeara vego". may shena chamishshim ish? amar rabbi elazar: miyyaakov lamad, shenneemar: "vehaya hammachane hannishar lifleta". rabbi avahu amar: lefi sheen meara machzeket yoter mechamishshim.
"Chazon ovadyahu ko amar Adonai elohim leedom vegomer". may shena ovadya leedom?

Amar rabbi yitzchak: amar hakkadosh baruch hu, yavo ovadyahu haddar ben shene reshaim velo lamad mimmaasehem, veyinnave al esav harasha sheddar ben shene tzaddikim velo lamad mimmaasehem. amar efrayim mikshaa talmido shel rabbi meir mishshum rabbi meir: ovadya ger adomi haya. vehayeynu deamri inashe: minneh uveh ibba nezil beh narga.

"Vayyach et moav vaymaddedem bachevel hashekev otam artza". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, hayeynu deamri inashe: minneh uveh ibba lezil beh narga. ki ata rav dimi amar: yarech mittochah masrachat.
"Vayyikkach et beno habbechor asher yimloch tachtav vayyaalehu ola al hachoma". rav ushemuel, chad amar: leshem shamayim, vechad amar: leshem avoda zara.
Bishlama leman deamar leshem shamayim, hayeynu dichtiv "vayhi ketzef gadol al yisrael". ella leman deamar leshem avoda zara, ammay "vayhi ketzef"?

Kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi, derabbi yehoshua ben levi rame: ketiv "uchemishpete haggoyim asher sevivotechem lo asitem", uchetiv "uchemishpete haggoyim asher sevivotechem asitem". kamtukkanin shebbahem – lo asitem, kamkulekalin shebbahem – asitem.
"Vayyisu mealav vayyashuvu laaretz". amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: beotah shaa yardu sonehen shel yisrael lemadrega hattachtona.
"Vehannaara yafa ad meod". amar rabbi chanina bar pappa: adayin lo higgia lachatzi yofi shel sara, dichtiv "ad meod" – velo meod bakkelal.
Hadaran alach echad dine mamonot

a: Mishna hayu bodkin otan besheva chakirot: beezo shavua, beezo shana, beezo chodesh, bechamma bachodesh, beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze mekom. rabbi yose omer: beeze yom, beezo shaa, beeze makom.
Makkirin attem oto? hitretem bo? haoved avoda zara: et mi avad, uvamme avad?
Kol hammarbe bivdikot – hare ze meshubbach. maase uvadak ben zakkay beuketze teenim.

Ma ben chakirot livdikot? chakirot – echad omer "eni yodea", edutan betela. bedikot – echad omer "eni yodea", vaafillu shenayim omrim "en anu yodin", edutan kayyemet. echad chakirot veechad bedikot, bizman shemmachchishin ze et ze – edutan betela.
Echad omer: "bishnayim bechodesh", veechad omer: "bishlosha bachodesh" – edutan kayyemet, shezze yodea beibburo shel chodesh, veze eno yodea beibburo shel chodesh.
Echad omer: "bishlosha", veechad omer "bachamishsha" – edutan betela.
Echad omer: "bishte shaot", veechad omer: "beshalosh shaot" – edutan kayyemet. echad omer: "beshalosh", veechad omer: "bechamesh" – edutan betela.
Rabbi yehuda omer: kayyemet. echad omer "bechamesh", veechad omer "besheva" – edutan betela, shebbechamesh chamma bammizrach uvesheva chamma bammaarav.

Veachar kach machnisin et hashsheni uvodkin oto. im nimtzeu divrehem mechuvvavnim, potchin bizchut. amar echad min haedim: "yesh li lelammed alav zechut", o echad min hattalmidim: "yesh li lelammed alav chova" – meshattekin oto. amar echad min hattalmidim: "yesh li lelammed alav zechut" – maalin oto umoshivin oto benehem, velo haya yored mishsham kol hayyom kullo.
Im yesh mammash bidvarav, shomin lo. vaafillu hu omer: "yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut", shomin lo, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav.

Veim matzu lo zechut, petaruhu. veim lav, maavirin oto lemachar, umizdavvevgin zugot zugot. hayu memaatin mimmaachol, velo hayu shotin yayin kol hayyom, venosin venotnin kol hallayla. velammochorat mashkimin uvain levet din.

Hamezakke omer: "ani mezakke, umezakke ani bimkomi". vehamechayyev omer: "ani mechayyev, umechayyev ani bimkomi". hamelammed chova melammed zechut, aval hamelammed zechut eno yachol lachzor ulelammed chova. tau baddavar – shene sofre haddayyaynin mazkirin oto. im matzu lo zechut – petaruhu, veim lav – omdim lamminyan. shenem asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyeyvin – zakkay.

Shenem asar mechayyeyvin veachad asar mezakkin, vaafillu achad asar mezakkin veachad asar mechayyeyvin veechad omer "eni yodea", vaafillu esrim ushenayim mezakkin o mechayyeyvin veechad omer "eni yodea" – yosifu haddayyaynin. vechamma mosifin? shenayim shenayim, ad shivim veechad.

Sheloshim veshishsha mezakkin usheloshim vachamishsha mechayyeyvin – zakkay. sheloshim veshishsha mechayyeyvin usheloshim vachamishsha mezakkin – danin ellu keneged ellu, ad sheyyire echad min hamechayyeyvin divre hamezakkin.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rav yehuda: deamar kera "vedarashta vechakarta veshaalta hetev", veomer "vehuggad lecha veshamata vedarashta hetev", veomer "vedarshu hashshoftim hetev".
b: Veema: chada chada kedichtiva? deim ken, lichtevinhu rachamana bachada! kevan dechullehu bahade hadade ketiva, mehadade yalfi, vechevan deyalfi mehadade, keman dichtiv bachada dame.
Veha la damyan lahadade? (siman: palet, sayif, hateraa.)
Ir hanniddachat lehanach tarte la damya, shekken mamonan palet. avoda zara lehanach tarte la damya, shekken besayif. edim zommin lehanach tarte la damya, shekken tzerichim hateraa.

Behetev" "hetev" yalfinan mehadade, ugezera shava mufena. dei la mufena, ikka lemifrach. laye, afnoye mufene. middahava leh lemichtav "vedarshu vechakru", veshanni kera bedibbureh behetev", shema minna leafnoye.
Veakkatti mufene mitztzad echad hu! bishlama hanach tarte mufene hu, mishshum dahava leh lemichtav. ella ir hanniddachat, may hava leh lemichtav? ha ketiva kullehu!
Hatam name afnoye mufene, middahava leh lemichtav "darosh tidrosh" o "chakor tachkor", veshanni kera bedibbureh behetev" – shema minna leafnoye.
Veatu nechnakin bekal vachomer minniskalin uminneheragin, veatu nisrafin bekal vachomer minniskalin.
Hanicha lerabbanan deamri sekila chamura, ella lerabbi shimon deamar serefa chamura, may ikka lememar?
Ella amar rav yehuda: "vehinne emet nachon", "vehinne emet nachon" – ha chad sere. sheva – lesheva chakirot, dal telat – ligzera shava, pasha lehu chada.
Lerabbi shimon, leetoye nisrafin. lerabbanan, milleta deatya bekal vachomer – tarach vechatav la kera.
Megaddef ba rabbi avahu: ema leetoye shemone chakirot! ushemone chakirot mi ikka?! allema la? vehaikka leetoye bechamma beshaa. vetanya name hachi: hayu bodkin oto bishmone chakirot.

Hanicha leabbaye allibba derabbi meir, deamar: en adam toe velo kelum, ulehach lishshana name deamar: adam toe mashshehu – shappir. ella leabbaye allibba derabbi yehuda, deamar: adam toe chatzi shaa, ulerava deamar: tau inashe tuva – may ikka lememar?
Ella, leetoye bechamma bayyovel.
Hayeynu beeze shavua! ella, leetoye beeze yovel. veiddach: kevan deamar beeze shavua, la bae beeze yovel.
Rabbi yose omer. tanya, amar lahem rabbi yose lachachamim: ledivrechem, mi shebba veamar "emesh harago", omer lo "beezo shavua?", "beezo shana?", "beeze chodesh?", "bechamma bachodesh?"
Amru lo: lidvarecha, mi shebba veamar "achshav harago", omer lo "beeze yom?", "beeze shaa?", "beeze makom?"
Ella, af al gav dela tzarich, ramenan aleh kidrabbi shimon ben elazar. hacha name, af al gav dela tzarich, ramenan aleh kidrabbi shimon ben elazar.
Verabbi yose: "emesh harago" – shechiach berov ediyyot, "achshav harago" – la shechiach berov ediyyot.
Makkirim attem oto. tanu rabbanan: makkirim attem oto? nochri harag? yisrael harag? hitritem bo? kibbel alav hateraa? hittir atzmo lemita? hemit betoch kede dibbur?
Haoved avoda zara. et mi avad: lifor avad? lemarkulis avad? uvamma avad: bezibbuach? bekittur? benissuch? behishtachavaa?

Amar ulla: minnayin lehateraa min hattora? shenneemar: "veish asher yikkach et achoto bat aviv o vat immo veraa et ervatah". attu biriyya talya milleta? ella ad sheyyaruhu tamo shel davar. im eno inyan lecharet –

a: Tenehu inyan lemalkut.
Deve chizkiyya tana: "vechi yazid ish al reehu lehorgo veorma" – shehitru bo, vaadayin hu mezid.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "hammotzim itto mekoshesh etzim" – shehitru bo, vaadayin hu mekoshesh.
Deve rabbi tana: "al devar asher inna" – al iske dibbur.
Utzericha, dei ketav rachamana "achoto" – hava amena: chayyayve malkot – in, chayyayve mitot – la. ketav rachamana "ki yazid".
Vei ketav rachamana "vechi yazid", hava amena: hane mille – sayif dekil, aval sekila dachamura – ema la. tzericha.
Vetarte beniskalin lema li? lerabbi shimon, leetoye nisrafin.
Lerabbanan, milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav la kera. velichtov rachamana beniskalin, veleto hanach veligmeru minneh? hacha name, milleta deatya bekal vachomer tarach vechatav la kera.
Hittir atzmo lemita, mena lan? amar rava, veittema chizkiyya, amar kera: "yumat hammet" – ad sheyyattir atzmo lemita.
Amar rav chanan: ede naara hameorasa shehuzzammu en neheragin, mittoch sheyyecholim lomar "leosrah al balah banu".
Veha atro ba? dela atro ba. vei la atro ba, hechi mikkatla?
Beishsha chavera, veallibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda. detanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: chaver en tzarich hateraa, lefi shello nittena hateraa ella lehavechin ben shogeg lemezid.
Vechevan deinhu la mikkatli, ihi hechi mikkatla? havya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah, vechol edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah lo shemah edut.
Hachi name kaamar: mittoch sheen neheragin, sheyyecholin lomar "leosrah al balah banu", af hi enah nehereget, dehavya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah.
Ella beishsha chavera, dekayyma lan demikkatla, allibba derabbi yose berabbi yehuda hechi mashkachat la? keshezzinneta, vechazra vezinneta.
Veha yecholin lomar: "leosrah al boalah sheni banu"! shezzinneta mibboel rishon, i name shezzinneta mikkeroveha.
May shena naara meorasa denaket? afillu nesua name! in, ella afillu hay dela yatva tuteh yecholin lomar: "leosrah al balah banu".
Amar rav chisda: echad omer "besayif harago", veechad omer "baariran harago" – en ze "nachon". echad omer "kelav shechorin", veechad omer "kelav levanim" – hare ze "nachon".

Metivi: "nachon" – sheyyehe nachon. echad omer: "besayif harago", veechad omer: "baariran harago". echad omer: "kelav shechorin", veechad omer: "kelav levanim" – en ze "nachon". targema rav chisda: besudar shechanako bo, dehayynu sayif vaariran.
Ta shema: echad omer "sandalav shechorin", veechad omer "sandalav levanim" – en ze "nachon". hatam name, kegon shebbaat bo besandalo vaharago.
Ta shema: maase, uvadak ben zakkay beuketze teena. amar rame bar chama: kegon sheakatz teena beshabbat, daala ka mikketil.
Veha tanya: amru lo "tachat teena harago"? ella amar rame bar chama: kegon sheshshippedo beyichur shel teena.
Ta shema, amar lahen: teena zo okatzeha dakkin? okatzeha gassin? teenim shechorot? teenim levanot? ella, amar rav yosef: mibben zakkay lotev inish? shane ben zakkay, divdikot kachakirot meshavve leh.

Man ben zakkay? illema rabbi yochanan ben zakkay, mi hava besanhedri? vehatanya: kol shenotav shel rabbi yochanan ben zakkay mea veesrim shana. arbaim shana asak bifrakmatya, arbaim shana lamad, arbaim shana limmed.

Vetanya: arbaim shana kodem chureban habbayit, galta sanhedrin veyashva lah bachanut. veamar rabbi yitzchak bar avudimi: lomar shello danu dine kenasot. dine kenasot salka datach? ella shello danu dine nefashot.
Utenan: mishshecharav bet hammikdash, hitkin rabban yochanan ben zakkay.
Ella, ben zakkay dealma. hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach rabban yochanan ben zakkay, kare leh rabbi "ben zakkay"?
Vehatanya: maase uvadak rabban yochanan ben zakkay beuketze teenim! ella, talmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo hava, vaamar milleta umistabbar lehu tameh,
b: Vekavuha bishmeh. ki hava lamad, "ben zakkay" hava kare leh, ketalmid hayyoshev lifne rabbo. ki hava limmed, hava kare leh "rabban yochanan ben zakkay". ki kare leh "ben zakkay" – al shem demeikkara, vechi kare leh "rabban yochanan ben zakkay" – al shem dehashta.
Maase uvadak kulei. ma ben chakirot kulei. may "afillu shenayim omrim"? peshita! ki amar echad "eni yodea" – edutan kayyemet, ki amri be tere name edutan kayyemet!
Amar rav sheshet: aresha kae, vehachi kaamar: bachakirot, afillu shenayim omrim "yadanu" veechad omer "eni yodea" – edutan betela. keman? kerabbi akiva, demakkesh shelosha lishnayim.
Amar rava: veha "edutan kayyemet" katane! ella amar rava: hachi kaamar: afillu bachakirot, shenayim omrim "yadanu" veechad omer "eni yodea" – edutan kayyemet. keman? dela kerabbi akiva.
Rav kahana verav safra tanu sanhedrin be rabba. pega behu rame bar chama. amar lehu: may amritu ba besanhedrin deve rabba? amri leh: umay amrinan ba besanhedrin geredta? umay kashya lach?

Amar lehu, meha dekatane: ma ben chakirot livdikot? chakirot – echad omer "eni yodea", edutan betela, bedikot – amar echad "eni yodea", vaafillu shenayim omrim "en anu yodim", edutan kayyemet. mikkede, idde veidde deorayyta hi, may shena chakirot umay shena bedikot?

Amri leh: hachi hasheta? bachakirot, amar echad "eni yodea" – edutan betela, dehavya la edut shei atta yachol lahazimmah. bedikot, amar echad mehen "eni yodea" – edutan kayyemet, edut sheatta yachol lahazimmah hu.
Amar lehu: i hachi amritu ba, tuva amritu ba. amri leh: mittevuteh demar amrinan ba tuva, minnezihuteh demar la amrinan ba vela chada.
Echad omer kulei. ad kamma? amar rabbi acha bar chanina, amar rabbi assi, amar rabbi yochanan: ad rubbo shel chodesh.

Amar rava: af anan name tenena, echad omer "bishlosha" veechad omer "bachamishsha" – edutan betela. veammay? nema shezze yodea bishne ibburin veze eno yodea bishne ibburin? ella lav, mishshum divrubba yada!
Leolam ema lach: berubba name la yada, uveshippura yada. bechad shippura amar detae, bitre shippure la amar detae.

Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: ad kamma mevarchin al hachodesh? ad shettitmalle pegimatah. vechamma? amar rav yaakov bar idi amar rav yehuda: ad shiva. nehardae amri: ad shishsha asar.

a: Vetarvayyhu kerabbi yochanan sevira lehu: ha lemihve ki yitra, ha lemihve ki nafya.

Amar leh rav acha middifti leravina: velivarech "hattov vehammetiv"! amar leh: attu ki chasar mi mevarchinan "dayyayn haemet", dilvarech "hattov vehammetiv"? velivarchinhu letarvayyhu? kevan dehayynu orcheh, la mevarchinan.

Veamar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: kol hamevarech al hachodesh bizmanno keillu mekabbel pene shechina. ketiv hacha "hachodesh hazze", uchetiv hatam "ze eli veanvehu". tana deve rabbi yishmael: ilmale lo zachu yisrael ella lehakebil pene avihen shebbashshamayim kol chodesh vachodesh, dayyaym. amar abbaye: hilkach nemrinhu meummad.
Marimar umar zutera mechattefi ahadade umevarchi. amar leh rav acha lerav ashe: bemareva mevarchi "baruch mechaddesh chodashim". amar leh: hay neshe didan name mevarchi.

Ella kidrav yehuda, deamar rav yehuda: "baruch [vechulei] asher bemaamaro bara shechakem, uveruach piv kol tzevaam. chok uzeman natan lahem shello yeshannu et tafkidam, sasim usemechim laasot retzon konam. poale emet sheppeullatan emet. velallevana amar shettitchaddesh ateret tiferet laamuse vaten, shehen atidin lehitchaddesh kemotah ulefaer leyotzram al shem kevod malchuto. baruch atta Adonai mechaddesh chodashim".

Ki vetachbulot taase lecha milchama. amar rabbi acha bar chanina amar rabbi assi amar rabbi yochanan: bemi atta motze milchamtah shel tora? bemi sheyyesh beyado chavilot shel mishna. kare rav yosef annafsheh: "verov tevuot bechoach shor".
Echad omer bishte shaot kulei. amar rav shimi bar ashe: lo shanu ella shaot, aval echad omer kodem hanetz hachamma veechad omer leachar hanetz hachamma – edutan betela.
Peshita! ella: echad omer "kodem hanetz", veechad omer "betoch hanetz". ha name peshita! mahu detema: ha begilluya kae, vezaharure bealma hu dachaza – ka mashma lan.

Veachar kach machnisin kulei. oto hayyom vetu la? vehatanya: im yesh mammash bidvarav – lo haya yored mishsham leolam, veim en mammash bidvarav – en yored kol hayyom kullo, kede shello tehe aliyyayto yerida lo. amar abbaye: targuma aim en mammash bidvarav.
Matzu lo zechut kulei. yayin may tama la? amar rabbi acha bar chanina: amar kera "uleroznim e shechar" – haoskin berazo shel olam al yishtakkeru.
Matzu lo zechut kulei. lo rau, may?
Amar rabbi acha: potrin oto. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: potrin oto. amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: veliftereh meikkara! amar leh: hachi amar rabbi yochanan: kede shello yetzu mibbet din meurebavin.

Ikka deamri: amar leh rav pappa leabbaye, ulema li yosifu? liftereh mibbe dina kamma! amar leh: rabbi yose kae kevavtach, detanya: rabbi yose omer, keshem sheen mosifin al bet din shel shivim veechad, kach en mosifin al bet din shel esrim ushelosha.
Tanu rabbanan: omer bedine mamonot "nizdakken haddin", veen omer bedine nefashot "nizdakken haddin".

May "nizdakken haddin"? illema kash dina, ippecha mibbaya leh! amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: efoch. rav ashe amar: leolam la tefoch, umay "nizdakken haddin" – chacham dina.
Metivi: gadol shebbaddayyaynin omer "nizdakken haddin". i amrat bishlama chacham dina, hayeynu deamar gadol. ella i amrat kash dina, la saggi dela amar gadol? kassofe hu deka meychassef nafsheh?
In. eno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo, lemitbayyesh meacherim.

Ikka deamri: i amrat bishlama kash dina, hayeynu deeno dome mitbayyesh meatzmo lemitbayyesh meacherim. ella i amrat chacham dina, gadol ashboche mashbach nafsheh? vehachtiv: "yehallelcha zar velo ficha"!
Shane milleta deve dina, deaggadol ramya. keditnan: gamru et haddavar, hayu machnisin otan. gadol shebbaddayyaynin omer: "ish peloni atta zakkay", "ish peloni atta chayyayv".
Hadaran alaych hayu bodkin
b: Mishna nigmar haddin, motziin oto lesoklo. bet hassekila haya chutz levet din, shenneemar: "hotze et hamekallel".

Echad omed al petach bet din, vehassudarin beyado, vesus rachok mimmennu kede sheyyehe roehu. omer echad: "yesh lelammed alav zechut", halla menif besudarin, vehassus ratz umaamidan. vaafillu hu omer: "yesh li lelammed al atzmi zechut", machazirin oto, afillu arba vechamesh peamim, uvilvad sheyyesh mammash bidvarav.
Gemara uvet hassekila chutz levet din hava, vetu la? veha tanya: bet hassekila haya chutz leshalosh machanot.

In, kidkaamrat. veha dekatane hachi, nafka minna dei nafek be dina veyatev chutz leshalosh machanot, avdinan bet hassekila chutz levet din, ki hechi dela mitchaze bet din rotzchin. i name, ki hechi detihve leh hatztzala.

Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "hotze et hamekallel el michutz lammachane" – chutz leshalosh machanot. atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot, o eno ella chutz lemachane achat? neemar kan "michutz lammachane", veneemar befarim hannisrafin "chutz lemachane". ma lehallan – chutz leshalosh machanot, af kan – chutz leshalosh machanot.
Vehatam menalan? detanu rabbanan: "vehotzi et kol happar el michutz lammachane" – chutz leshalosh machanot. atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot, o eno ella chutz lemachane achat?
Keshehu omer "el michutz lammachane" befar haeda, sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar "vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon" – litten lo machane sheniyya.
Ucheshehu omer "al michutz lammachane" bedeshen, sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar "al shefech haddeshen yissaref" – litten lo machane shelishit.
Velelaf mishshechute chutz? ma lehallan chutz lemachane achat, af kan chutz lemachane achat.
Mistabbera, mipparim hannisrafin hava leh lemelaf,
Shekken "hotze el michutz lammachane", machshir umechapper.
Adderabba, mishshechute chutz hava leh lemelaf,
Shekken adam chote, binshama, piggul.
Machshir mimmachshir adif leh.

Rav pappa amar: moshe hecha hava yatev? bemachane leviyyay. vaamar leh rachamana: "hotze et hamekallel el michutz lammachane" – chutz lemachane leviyyay. "vayyotziu et hamekallel el michutz lammachane" – chutz lemachane yisrael.
Hay mibbee leh laasiyyay? asiyyay behedya ketiva:

a: "Uvene yisrael asu kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe".
Ella meatta: "vayyirgemu oto aven" may avdi leh? hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "vayyirgemu oto baaven" – "oto" velo bichsuto, "aven" sheim met beeven achat yatza.

Veitzterich lemichtav "aven", veitzterich lemichtav "avanim". dei ketav rachamana "aven", hava amena: hecha dela met bachada, la nayte achariti venikteleh. ketav rachamana "avanim". vei ketav rachamana "avanim", hava amena: meikkara nayyte tarte. ketav rachamana "aven".
Veha hay tanna "neemar" kaamar? "illu lo neemar" kaamar, vehachi kaamar: illu lo neemar kera, hayiti omer gezera shava. achshav shenneemar kera, gezera shava la tzerich.

Rav ashe amar: moshe hecha hava yatev? bemachane leviyyay. vaamar leh rachamana: "hotze et hamekallel" – chutz lemachane leviyyay. "el michutz lammachane" – chutz lemachane yisrael. "vayyotziu et hamekallel" – laasiyyay.
Asiyyay behedya ketiv behu: "uvene yisrael asu kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe". hahu mibbee leh, chad lismicha vechad lidchiyyay.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerav ashe: ledidach, kol hane "hotzi" dichtivi befarim hannisrafim, may darshat behu? kashya.

Echad omed kulei. amar rav huna: peshita li, echad even shenniskal bah, veechad etz shennitle bo, veechad sayif shenneherag bo, veechad sudar shennechnak bo – kullan mishshel tzibbur. may tama? demiddideh la amrinan leh: "zil veleteh veliktol nafsheh".
Bae rav huna: sudar shemmenifin bo, vesus sheratz umaamidan – mishshel mi hu? kevan dehatztzala dideh, middideh hu? o dilma, kevan deve dina mechayyeyvin lemebad leh hatztzala, middidhu?

Vetu, ha deamar rav chiyyay bar rav ashe amar rav chisda: hayyotze lehareg mashkin oto koret shel levona bechos shel yayin kede shettittaref dato, shenneemar: "tenu shechar leoved veyayin lemare nafesh". vetanya: nashim yekarot shebbirushalayim hayu mitnaddevot umeviot otan. lo hitnaddevu nashim yekarot, mishshel mi? ha vadday mistabbera mishshel tzibbur, kevan dichtiv "tenu" – middidhu.

Bea minneh rav acha bar huna merav sheshet: amar echad min hattalmidim "yesh li lelammed alav zechut", venishtattek, mahu? menappach rav sheshet bideh. nishtattek? afillu echad besof haolam name! hatam la kaamar, hacha kaamar. may?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: echad min hattalmidim shezzikka vamet, roin oto keillu chay veomed bimkomo. zikka – in, lo zikka – la.
Zikka – peshita li; amar – tibbee lach.

Afillu hu kulei. vaafillu paam rishona usheniyya? vehatanya: paam rishona usheniyya, ben sheyyesh mammash bidvarav ben sheen mammash bidvarav – machzirin oto. mikkan vaelach, im yesh mammash bidvarav – machzirin oto, en mammash bidvarav – en machzirin oto.
Amar rav pappa: targuma mippaam sheniyya veelach.
Mena yadi? amar abbaye: demasrinan leh zuga derabbanan. i ikka mammash bidvarav – in, i la – la.
Velimsar leh meikkara? aggav divit, la matze amar kol may deit leh.

Mishna matzu lo zechut – petaruhu, veim lav – yotze lissakel. vecharoz yotze lefanav: "ish peloni ben peloni yotze lissakel al sheavar avera pelonit, ufeloni ufeloni edav. kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav".
Gemara amar abbaye: vetzarich lememar beyom peloni, uveshaa pelonit, uvemakom peloni. dilma ikka deyadaoy veate umazzem lehu.

Vecharoz yotze lefanav. lefanav – in, meikkara – la. vehatanya: beerev happesach telauhu leyeshu hannotzri, vehakkaroz yotze lefanav arbaim yom: "yeshu hannotzri yotze lissakel al shekkishshef vehesit vehiddiach et yisrael. kol mi sheyyodea lo zechut yavo vilammed alav". velo matzu lo zechut, utelauhu beerev happesach.
Amar ulla: vetisbera? yeshu hannotzri bar happoche zechut hu? mesit hu, verachamana amar: "lo tachmol velo techasse alav!" ella shane yeshu, dekarov lemalchut hava.

Tanu rabbanan: chamishsha talmidim hayu lo leyeshu hannotzri – mattay, nakkay, netzer, uvuni, vetoda. atyu lemattay. amar lehu: mattay yehareg? hachtiv "mattay avo veerae pene elohim"? amru lo: in, mattay yehareg, dichtiv: "matay yamut veavad shemo".
Atyu lenakkay. amar lehu: nakkay yehareg? hachtiv "venaki vetzaddik al taharog"? amru lo: in, nakkay yehareg, dichtiv: "bammistarim yaharog naki".
Atyu lenetzer. amar: netzer yehareg? hachtiv "venetzer mishshorashav yifre"? amru lo: in, netzer yehareg, dichtiv: "veatta hoshlachta mikkivrecha kenetzer nitav".
Atyu levuni. amar: buni yehareg? hachtiv "beni vechori yisrael"! amru lo: in, buni yehareg, dichtiv: "hinne anochi horeg et bincha bechorecha".
Atyu letoda. amar: toda yehareg? hachtiv "mizmor letoda"? amru lo: in, toda yehareg, dichtiv: "zoveach toda yechabbedanni".
b: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hazzoveach et yitzro umitvadde alav, maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbedo lehakkadosh baruch hu bishne olamim – haolam hazze vehaolam habba, dichtiv: "zoveach toda yechabbedanni".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, adam makriv ola – sechar ola beyado, mincha – sechar mincha beyado. aval mi sheddato shefala, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hikriv kol hakkarbanot kullan, shenneemar: "zivche elohim ruach nishbara". velo od, ella sheen tefillato nimeset, shenneemar: "lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze".

Mishna haya rachok mibbet hassekila keeser ammot, omrim lo: "hitvadde", shekken derech kol hammumatin mitvaddin. shekkol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shekken matzinu beachan sheamar lo yehoshua: "beni sim na chavod laAdonai elohe yisrael veten lo toda". "vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati vechazot vechazot vegomer". uminnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo? shenneemar: "vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai bayyom hazze". beyom hazze atta achur, vei atta achur laolam habba.

Veim eno yodea lehitvavdot, omrim lo, emor: "tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay". rabbi yehuda omer: im haya yodea shehu mezummam, omer: "tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay chutz meavon ze". amru lo: im ken, yehu kol adam omrin ken kede lenakkot atzman.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "na" – en "na" ella leshon bakkasha.

Beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lihoshua: "chata yisrael", amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi chata? amar leh: vechi delator ani? lech happel goralot. halach vehippil goralot, venafal haggoral al achan. amar lo: yehoshua, begoral atta ba alay? atta veelazar hakkohen shene gedole haddor attem. im ani mappil alechem goral, al echad mikkem hu nofel. amar lo: bevakkasha mimmecha, al totzi laaz al haggoralot, sheatida eretz yisrael shettitchallek begoral, shenneemar: "ach begoral yechalek et haaretz".

"Ten toda". amar ravina, shachode shachadeh bemille: kelum nevakkesh mimmecha ella hodaa? ten lo toda vehippater. miyyad: "vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael vechazot vechazot asiti".

Amar rav assi amar rabbi chanina: melammed shemmaal achan bishlosha charamim, shenayim bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua, shenneemar: "kazot vechazot asiti". rabbi yochanan amar mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: chamishsha, arbaa bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua, shenneemar: "anochi chatati vechazot vechazot asiti".
Vead hasheta, may tama la ianush? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: lefi shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden.

Ketannae: "hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad olam". lamma nakud al "lanu ulevanenu" veal ayin shebbead"? melammed shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden, divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi anash al hannistarot leolam? vahalo kevar neemar "ad olam"! ella, keshem shello anash al hannistarot, kach lo anash al onashin shebbaggaluy ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden. ella

a: Achan, may tama ianush? mishshum dahavo yadi beh ishto uvanav.
"Chata yisrael". amar rabbi abba bar zavda: af al pi shechata, yisrael hu. amar rabbi abba: hayeynu deamri inashe: asa dekae bene chilfe, asa shemeh, veasa karu leh.

"Vegam avru et beriti asher tzivviti otam gam lakchu min hacherem gam ganvu gam kichashu gam samu bichlehem". amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta: melammed sheavar achan al chamishsha chumeshe tora, shenneemar chamishsha "gam".
Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta: achan moshech beorlato haya. ketiv hacha "vegam avru et beriti", uchetiv hatam "et beriti hefar".
Peshita! mahu detema: bemitzva gufeh la pekar? ka mashma lan.
Vechi asa nevala beyisrael. amar rabbi abba bar zavda: melammed shebbaal achan naara hameorasa. ketiv hacha "vechi asa nevala", uchetiv hatam "ki asta nevala beyisrael".
Peshita! mahu detema kulle hay la pekar nafsheh, ka mashma lan. ravina amar: dineh kenaara hameorasa, deviskila.

Amar leh resh galuta lerav huna: ketiv: "vayyikkach yehoshua et achan ben zerach veet hakkesef veet haadderet veet leshon hazzahav veet banav veet benotav veet shoro veet chamoro veet tzono veet oholo veet kol asher lo". im hu chata, banav uvenotav me chatu?
Amar leh: velitamaych, im hu chata – kol yisrael me chatu? dichtiv: "vechol yisrael immo". ella lirdotan. hachi name, kede lirdotan.
"Vayyisrefu otam baesh vayyiskelu otam baavanim". betarte? amar ravina: harauy lisrefa – lisrefa, harauy liskila – liskila.
"Vaere vashshalal adderet shinar achat tova umatayim shekalim kesef". rav amar: itztela demelata, ushemuel amar: sarbala ditzrifa.

"Vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai". amar rav nachman: ba vachavatam lifne hammakom. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, al ellu tehareg rubbah shel sanhedrin? dichtiv: "vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish". vetanya: sheloshim veshishsha mammash, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi sheloshim veshishsha hayu? vahalo lo neemar ella "kishloshim veshishsha ish"! ella ze yair ben menashshe sheshshakul keneged rubbah shel sanhedrin.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: may dichtiv "tachanunim yedabber rash veashir yaane azzot"? "tachanunim yedabber rash" – ze moshe, "veashir yaane azzot" – ze yehoshua.

May tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai", veamar rav nachman: ba vachavatan lifne hammakom. attu pinchas la avad hachi? dichtiv: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel vatteatzar hammaggefa", veamar rabbi elazar: "vayyitpallel" lo neemar ella "vayfallel", melammed sheasa pelilut im kono. ba vachavatan lifne hammakom, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, al ellu yippelu esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael? dichtiv: "veyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef".
Veella mehacha: "lamma heavarta haavir et haam hazze et hayyarden". moshe name memar amar: "lema hareota laam hazze". ella mehacha: "velu hoalnu vanneshev beever hayyarden".

"Vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach". daresh rabbi shela: amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu: shellecha kasha mishshellahem. ani amarti "vehaya beovrechem et hayyarden takimu", veattem richaktem shishshim mil.
Batar dinfak, okem rav amora aleh uderash: "kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe avdo ken tzivva moshe et yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo hesir davar mikkol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe".
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "kum lach"? amar lo: atta garamta lahem. vehayeynu dekaamar leh beay: "veasita laay ulemalkah kaasher asita liricho ulemalkah vegomer".

"Vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vegomer vayyomer lo ki ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati [vayyippol yehoshua el panav artza vayyishtachu]". hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: asur lo leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero ballayla, chayyshinan shemma shed hu!
Shane hatam, dekaamar leh: "ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati vegomer". vedilma meshakkeri? gemiri dela mappeki shem shamayim levattala.
b: Amar leh: emesh bittaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim, veachshav bittaltem talmud tora. al eze mehen bata? amar leh: "atta bati".
Miyyad "vayyalen yehoshua ballayla hahu betoch haemek", veamar rabbi yochanan: melammed shellan beumekah shel halacha.
Amar shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: gadol talmud tora yoter mehakeravat temidin, shenneemar: "atta vati".
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: hay kera bemareva bemay mokmitu leh: "al tetze lariv maher pen ma taase beacharitah behachelim otcha reecha. rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal"?

Beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lichezkel: lech emor lahem leyisrael "avich haemori veimmech chittit", amra ruach piskonit lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, im yavou avraham vesara veyaamdu lefanecha, atta omer lahem umachlim otam? "rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal"!

Umi it leh reshuta kulle hay? in, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shalosh shemot yesh lo – piskon, itmon, sigron. piskon – shepposek devarim kelappe mala, itmon – sheotem avonotehen shel yisrael, sigron – kevan shessoger shuv eno poteach.
