"Hayaaroch shuacha lo vetzar", amar rabbi elazar: leolam yakdim adam tefilla latztzara, sheilmale lo hikdim avraham tefilla latztzara ben bet el uven haay, lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit. resh lakish amar: kol hameammetz atzmo bitfilla millematta, en lo tzarim millemala. rabbi yochanan amar: leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim sheyyehu hakkol meammetzin et kocho, veal yehu lo tzarim millemala.

Minnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo vechulei? tanu rabbanan: minnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo? shenneemar: "vayyomer lo yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai hayyom hazze". hayyom hazze atta achur, vei atta achur laolam habba. uchetiv: "uvene zerach zimri veetan veheman vechalkol vedarda kullam chamishsha". may "kullam chamishsha"? kullan chamishsha hen laolam habba.

Ketiv "zimri", uchetiv "achan". rav ushemuel: chad amar, achan shemo, velamma nikra shemo zimri? sheasa maase zimri. vechad amar, zimri shemo, velamma nikra shemo achan? sheikken avonotehen shel yisrael.
Im eno yodea lehitvavdot kulei. rabbi yehuda omer kulei. lenakkot atzman, vinakku atzman! kede shello lehotzi laaz al batte dinin veal haedim.

Tanu rabbanan: maase beadam echad sheyyatza lehareg. amar: im yesh bi avon ze, lo tehe mitati kappara lechol avonotay. veim en bi avon ze, tehe mitati kappara lechol avonotay, uvet din vechol yisrael menukkin, vehaedim lo tehe lahem mechila leolam. uchesheshshamu chachamim baddavar, amru: lehacheziro i efshar, shekkevar nigzera gezera. ella yehareg, vihe kolar taluy betzavvar edim.
Peshita, kol keminneh? la tzericha deka hadri behu sahadi.
Vechi hadri behu, may have? kevan shehiggid, shuv eno chozer umaggid! la tzericha, deaf al gav deka yahavi tama lemilletayyhu, ki hahu maase devaya mochsa.

Mishna haya rachok mibbet hassekila arba ammot, mafshitin oto et begadav. haish mechassin oto millefanav, vehaishsha millefaneha umeachareha, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma.

a: Gemara tanu rabbanan: haish mechassin oto perek echad millefanav, veishsha shene perakim – ben millefaneha ben milleachareha, mippene shekkullah erva. divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: haish niskal arom, veen haishsha niskelet arumma.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? amar kera: "veragmu oto". may "oto"?
Illema oto velo otah, vehachtiv: "vehotzeta et haish hahu o et haishsha hahi"? ella may "oto"? oto belo kesuto, ha otah bichsutah. rabbi yehuda omer: oto belo kesuto, la shena ish vela shena ishsha.

Lememra derabbanan chayyshi lehirhura, verabbi yehuda la chayesh lehirhura? veha ippecha shemana lehu, ditnan: hakkohen ochez bivgadeha – im nikreu nikreu, veim nifremu nifremu, ad shemmegalle et libbah vesoter et searah. rabbi yehuda omer: im haya libbah nae lo haya megallehu, veim haya searah nae lo haya sotro.

Amar rabba: hatam hayeynu tama, shemma tetze mibbet din zakkaa veyitgaru bah pirche kehunna. hacha ha mikkatla. vechi tema: ate leitgaroye beachranyayta? amar rabba: gemiri, en yetzer hara sholet ella bemi sheenav root.
Amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda kashya, derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya? ella amar rava: derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya, kidshannin.
Derabbanan adderabbanan name la kashya. amar kera: "venivvasseru kol hannashim velo taasena kezimmatchena". hacha, en lecha yissur gadol mizze.
Vechi tema: lebed ba tarte? amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar kera "veahavta lereacha kamocha" – beror lo mita yafa.

Lema: derav nachman tannae hi? la, dechulle alma it lehu derav nachman, vehacha beha kamippalgi: mar savar bizyone deinish adif leh tefe minneyacha degufeh, umar savar neyacha degufeh adif mibbizyoneh.
Mishna bet hassekila haya gavoah shete komot. echad min haedim dochafo al motnav. nehpach al libbo, hofcho al motnav. veim met bah – yatza.
Veim lav, hashsheni notel et haeven venotno al libbo. im met bah – yatza, veim lav – regimato bechol yisrael, shenneemar: "yad haedim tihye bo varishona lahamito veyad kol haam baacharona".
Gemara tana: vekoma shello, hare kan shalosh. umi baenan kulle hay? ureminhu: ma bor shehu kede lehamit – asara tefachim, af kol kede lehamit – asara tefachim.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: amar kera "veahavta lereacha kamocha", beror lo mita yafa. i hachi, laygbeheh tefe! mishshum deminnavval.
Echad min haedim dochafo. tanu rabbanan: minnayin shebbidchiyyay? talmud lomar "yaro". uminnayin shebbiskila? talmud lomar "sakol".
Uminnayin shebbiskila uvidchiyyay? talmud lomar: "sakol yissakel o yaro yiyyare". uminnayin sheim met bidchiyyay yatza? talmud lomar: "o yaro yiyyare". minnayin sheaf ledorot ken?
b: Talmud lomar: "sakol yissakel".

Veim lav, ed hashsheni notel et haeven. notel? vehatanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, even hayta sham massoy shene bene adam, notlah venotnah al libbo. im met bah – yatza. velitamaych, tikshe lach hi gufa: massoy shene bene adam, notlah venotnah al libbo?
Ella, demadle la bahade chavreh, veshade la ihu, ki hechi detete merazya.
Veim lav, regimato kulei. vehatanya: meolam lo shana bah adam! mi kaamena deaved? dei mitztzerich kaamena.

Amar mar: even hayta kulei. vehatanya: achat even shenniskal bah, veachat etz shennitle alav, veechad sayif shenneherag bo, veechad sudar shennechnak bo – kullan nikbarin immo. la tzericha dimtakkeni umayyti acharine chillufayyhu.
Nikbarin immo. vehatanya: en nikbarin immo? amar rav pappa: may "immo"? immo bitfisato.
Amar shemuel: niktea yad haedim – patur. may tama? devaena "yad haedim tihye bo varishona", velekka.
Ella meatta, edim gidmin demeikkara, hachi name difsili? shane hatam, deamar kera: "yad haedim", shehayta kevar.
Metivi: kol makom sheyyeiduhu shenayim veyomru, "meidin anu beish peloni shennigmar dino bevet din peloni, ufeloni ufeloni edav" – hare ze yehareg. targema shemuel behen hen edav".

Umi baenan kera kedichtiv? vehatanya: "mot yumat hammakke rotzeach hu" – en li ella bemita hakketuva bo. minnayin sheim i atta yachol lahamito bemita hakketuva bo sheatta memito bechol mita sheatta yachol lahamito? talmud lomar: "mot yumat hammakke" – mikkol makom.
Shane hatam, deamar kera: "mot yumat".
Veligmar minneh? mishshum dehave rotzeach vegoel haddam shene ketuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene ketuvin habbain keechad en melammedin.

Rotzeach – ha daamaran. goel haddam may hi? detanya: "goel haddam yamit et harotzeach" – mitzva begoel haddam. uminnayin sheim en lo goel shebbet din maamidin lo goel? shenneemar: "befigo bo" – mikkol makom.
Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: umi la baenan kera kedichtiv? vehatnan: haya echad mehen giddem, o illem, o chigger, o some, o cheresh – eno naasa ben sorer umore.
Shenneemar: "vetafsu vo" – velo gidmin, "vehotziu oto" – velo chiggerin, "veamru" – velo illemin, "benenu ze" – velo somin, "enennu shomea bekolenu" – velo chershin.
May tama? lav mishshum devaenan kera kedichtiv? la, shane hatam, dechulleh kera yattira hu.
Ta shema: en lah rechov – en naaset ir hanniddachat, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: en lah rechov – osin lah rechov.
Ad kan la peligi, ella demar savar: "rechovah" demeikkara bainan, umar savar: rechovah dehashta name kidmeikkara dame. aval dechulle alma baenan kera kedichtiv.
Tannae hi, ditnan: en lo bohen yad, bohen regel, ozen yamanit – en lo tohora olamit. rabbi eliezer omer: noten al mekomo veyotze. rabbi shimon omer: noten al semolo veyotze.
Mishna kol hanniskalin nitlin, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: eno nitle ella hamegaddef vehaoved avoda zara.

Haish tolin oto panav kelappe haam, vehaishsha paneha kelappe haetz; divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim omrim: haish nitle veen haishsha nitlet. amar lahen rabbi eliezer: vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim beashkelon? amru lo: shemonim nashim tala, veen danin shenayim beyom echad.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehumat vetalita" – yachol kol hammumatin nitlin? talmud lomar: "ki killat elohim taluy". ma mekallel ze shebbiskila, af kol shebbiskila. divre rabbi eliezer.
Vachachamim omrim: ma mekallel ze shekkafar baikkar, af kol shekkafar baikkar.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbanan darshi kelale uferate, rabbi eliezer daresh ribbuye umiute.
Rabbanan darshi kelale uferate: "vehumat vetalita" – kelal, "ki killat" – perat. i havo mekarvi lahadade, amrinan: en bakkelal ella ma shebbapperat. hane – in, midde acharina – la.

a: Hasheta dimrachaki mehadade, ahani lerabboye avoda zara, dedame leh bechol mille.

Verabbi eliezer daresh ribbuye umiute, "vehumat vetalita" – ribbuy, "ki killat" – miut. i havo mekarvi lahadade, la havo merabbinan ella avoda zara dedame le bechol mille. hasheta dimrachaki mehadade, ahani lerabboye shear hanniskalin.
Haish tolin vechulei. may tama derabbanan? amar kera: "vetalita oto" – oto, velo otah. verabbi eliezer: "oto" – belo kesuto.
Verabbanan, in hachi name. ella amar kera: "vechi yihye veish chet" – ish, velo ishsha.

Verabbi eliezer, hay "vechi yihye veish" may daresh beh? amar resh lakish: hahu lemaote ben sorer umore. vehatanya: ben sorer umore niskal venitle, divre rabbi eliezer! ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: lerabbot ben sorer umore. may tama?
Deamar kera: "vechi yihye veish chet" – ish, velo ben. "chet" – mi sheal cheto neherag, yatza ben sorer umore sheal shum sofo neherag. have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot.

Amar lahen rabbi eliezer: vahalo shimon ben shatach tala nashim kulei? amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella bishte mitot, aval bemita achat – danin. veha maase deshimon ben shatach demita achat havay, veka amru leh deen danin!
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: lo shanu ella bemita achat keen shete mitot. vehechi dame? kegon shete averot. aval bemita achat vaavera achat – danin.
Metiv rav adda bar ahava: en danin shenayim beyom echad, vaafillu benoef venoefet. targema rav chisda: bevat kohen uvoalah,
O bevat kohen vezomme zommeha.
Tanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: shamati shebbet din makkin veonshin shello min hattora, velo laavor al divre tora, ella kede laasot seyayg lattora.

Umaase beechad sherachav al sus beshabbat bime yevanim, veheviuhu levet din usekaluhu, lo mippene sherauy lechach, ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach. shuv maase beadam echad shehetiach et ishto tachat hatteena, veheviuhu levet din vehilkuhu, lo mippene sherauy lechach, ella shehashshaa tzericha lechach.

Mishna ketzad tolin oto? meshakkein et hakkora baaretz, vehaetz yotze umakkif shete yadav zo al gav zo, vetole oto. rabbi yose omer: hakkora mutta al hakkotel, vetole oto kederech shehattabbachin osin.

Umattirin oto miyyad, veim lan – over alav belo taase, shenneemar: "lo talin nivlato al haetz ki kavor tikberennu ki killat elohim taluy vegomer". kelomar, mippene ma ze taluy? mippene shebberach et hashshem, venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel.

Amar rabbi meir: beshaa sheadam mitztaer, shechina ma lashon omeret? "kallani meroshi, kallani mizzeroi". im ken hammakom mitztaer al daman shel reshaim shennishpach, kal vechomer al daman shel tzaddikim.
Velo zo bilvad amru, ella kol hammelin et meto over belo taase. helino lichvodo, lehavi lo aron vetachrichim – eno over alav.

Velo hayu kovrin oto bekivrot avotav, ella shete batte kevarot hayu metukkanin levet din: achat lanneheragin velannechnakin, veachat lanniskalin velannisrafin. nitakkel habbasar, melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman. vehakkerovim baim veshoalim bishlom haddayyaynin uvishlom haedim, kelomar sheen belibbenu alechem sheddin emet dantem.
b: Velo hayu mitabbelin, aval onnin, sheen aninut ella ballev.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: illu neemar "chet vetalita", hayiti omer tolin oto veachar kach memitin oto, kederech shehammalchut osa. talmud lomar: "vehumat vetalita" – memitin oto veachar kach tolin oto. ha ketzad? meshahin oto ad samuch lishkiat hachamma, vegomrin et dino, umemitin oto, veachar kach tolin oto. echad kosher veechad mattir, kede lekayyem mitzvat teliyyay.
Tanu rabbanan: "etz" – shomea ani ben betalush ben bimchubbar. talmud lomar "ki kavor" – mi sheeno mechussar ella kevura, yatza ze shemchussar ketzitza ukevura.
Rabbi yose omer: mi sheeno mechussar ella kevura – yatza ze shemchussar telisha ukevura. verabbanan: telisha lav kelum hi.

Kelomar: mippene ma ze taluy? mippene shebberach kulei. tanya, omer rabbi meir: mashlu mashal, lema haddavar dome? lishne achim teomim beir achat. echad minnuhu melech, veechad yatza lelistiyyut. tzivva hammelech utelauhu. kol haroe oto omer: hammelech taluy. tzivva hammelech vehoriduhu.
Amar rabbi meir kulei. may mashma? amar abbaye: keman deamar "kal let". amar leh rava: im ken, "kaved alay roshi" "kaved alay zeroi" mibbee leh! ella amar rava: keman deamar "kil li alma".
Hay mibbee leh legufe? im ken, nema kera "mekallel". may "killat"? veema: kulleh lehachi hu daata? im ken, nema kera "kallat". may "killat"? shema minna tarte.

Velo zo bilvad kulei. amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: minnayin lammelin et meto sheover alav belo taase? talmud lomar: "ki kavor tikberennu". mikkan lammelin et meto sheover belo taase.
Ikka deamri: amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay, remez likvura min hattora minnayin? talmud lomar: "ki kavor tikberennu". mikkan remez likvura min hattora.
Amar leh shabbur malka lerav chama: kevura min hattora minnayin? ishtik vela amar leh vela midde. amar rav acha bar yaakov: immesar alma bida detafshae, deibbei leh lememar "ki kavor".
Deleeved leh aron. "tikberennu"! la mashma leh.
Venema: middeikkevur tzaddike? minhaga bealma! middekavreh hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe? dela lishtanne mimminhaga.
Ta shema: "vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto". dela lishtanne mimminhaga.
"Lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru ledomen al pene haadama yihyu". delishtanno mimminhaga.
Ibbaya lehu: kevura mishshum bizyona hu, o mishshum kappara hu?
Lemay nafka minna? deamar: la baena delikberu lehahu gavra. i amrat mishshum bizyona hu – la kol keminneh, vei amrat mishshum kappara hu – ha amar: la baena kappara. may?
Ta shema: middeikkevur tzaddike, vei amrat mishshum kappara – tzaddike lechappara tzerichi? in, dichtiv: "adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov velo yecheta".

Ta shema: "vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto". vei amrat, ki hechi deteheve leh kappara, hanach name likkavru ki hechi deteheve lehu kappara? hay detzaddik hu – teheve leh kappara, hanach – la leheve lehu kappara.
Ta shema: "lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru", dela teheve lehu kappara.
Ibbaya lehu: hespeda, yekara dechaye have o yekara deshachve have? lemay nafka minna? deamar: la tispedu lehahu gavra. i name, leappoke miyyorshin.
Ta shema: "vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah". vei amrat mishshum yekara dechayye hu, mishshum yekara deavraham meshahu la lesara? sara gufa nicha lah, ki hechi demiyyaykkar ba avraham.
Ta shema: "vesafdu lo chol yisrael vekavru oto". vei amrat mishshum yekara dechayye hu, hanach bene yekara ninhu? nicha lehu letzaddikayya demiyyaykkeri behu inashe.
Ta shema: "lo yissafdu velo yikkaveru". la nicha letzaddikayya demiyyaykkeri barshiiyyay.

Ta shema: "beshalom tamut uvemisrefot avotecha hammelachim harishonim asher hayu lefanecha ken yisrefu lach vehoy adon yispedu lach". vei amrat mishshum yekara dechaye hu, may nafka leh minneh? hachi kaamar leh: liyyaykkeru baych yisrael ki hechi demityaykkeri baavahatach.

a: Ta shema: "nivze beenav nimas" – ze chizkiyyahu melech yehuda, sheggerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim. vei mishshum yekara dechayye hu, may tama?
Ki hechi detihve leh kappara laavu, umishshum kappara daavu meshahu leh likara deyisrael? yisrael gufayyhu nicha lehu demachali yekarayyhu legabbeh.
Ta shema, amar lahen: al tispeduni baayayrot. vei amrat yekara dechayye, may nafka leh minna? kasavar: lityaykkeru beh yisrael tefe.
Ta shema: helino lichvodo, lehavi lo aron vetachrichin – eno over alav. may lav lichvodo shel met? lo, lichvodo shel chay.
Umishshum kevodo shel chay mevit leh lemet? in, ki amar rachamana: "lo talin nivlato al haetz", dumeya detaluy deit beh bizzayon. aval hacha, kevan delet beh bizzayon – la.

Ta shema: helino lichvodo, leshammea alav ayayrot, lehavi lo mekonnot, lehavi lo aron vetachrichin – eno over alav, shekkol haose eno ella lichvodo shel met. hachi kaamar: kol haose lichvodo shel chay, en bo bizzayon lammet.

Ta shema, rabbi natan omer: siman yafe lammet shennifrain mimmennu leachar mita. met shello nispad velo nikbar, o shechayya gorarto, o shehayu geshamim mezallefin al mittato – zehu siman yafe lammet. shema minna: yekara deshachve hu. shema minna.

Lo hayu kovrin kulei. vechol kach lamma? lefi sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik, deamar rabbi acha bar chanina: minnayin sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik? shenneemar: "vayhi hem kovrim ish vehinne rau et haggedud vayyashlichu et haish bekever elisha vayyigga haish beatzmot elisha vaychi vayyakom al raglav".
Amar leh rav pappa: vedilma leikkeyome "vihi na pi shenayim beruchacha elay"? amar leh: i hachi, hayeynu detanya: al raglav amad, uleveto lo halach.
Ella "vihi na pi shenayim", hechi mashkachat la deachaye? amar leh rabbi yochanan: sherippe tzaraat naaman, shehi shekula kemet, dichtiv "al na tehi kammet".
Ucheshem sheen kovrin rasha etzel tzaddik, kach en kovrin rasha chamur etzel rasha kal. velitkon arba kevarot! shene kevarot gemara gemiri la.
Amar ulla amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, vehishtammed vechazar bo – hoil venidcha, yiddache.
Ittemar name, amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi avahu amar rabbi yochanan: achal chelev vehifrish korban, venishtatta, vechazar venishtappa – hoil venidcha, yiddache.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta – mishshum deihu decha nafsheh beyadayim, aval hay demimmela ka dache – ema keyashen dame.
Vei ashmeinan hacha, mishshum deen beyado lachzor, aval hatam divyado lachzor, ema la. tzericha.

Amar rav yosef: af anan name tenena, hayu bah kodashim, kodshe mizbeach yamutu, kodshe bedek habbayit yippadu. vehavenan ba: ammay yamutu? kevan deikketul havya lehu kappara, velisseku legavoah! lav mishshum deamrinan: hoil venidchu, yiddachu?

Amar leh abbaye: mi savrat met mittoch risho havya leh kappara? met mittoch risho la havya leh kappara, detane rav shemaya: yachol afillu pershu avotav middarche tzibbur yittamme? talmud lomar "beammav" – beose maase ammav.

Amar leh rava: mi ka medammet neherag mittoch risho lemet mittoch risho? met mittoch risho, kevan dechi orcheh kamayet – la havya leh kappara. neherag mittoch risho, kevan delav ki orcheh mayet – havya leh kappara.

Tidda, dichtiv: mizmor leasaf elohim bau goyim benachalatecha timmeu et hechal kodshecha [vegomer] natnu et nivlat avadecha maachol leof hashshamayim besar chasidecha lechayto aretz". may "avadecha" umay "chasidecha"? lav "chasidecha" – chasidecha mammash, "avadecha" – hanach dimchayyeyvi dina demeikkara, vechevan deikketul kare lehu "avadecha".
Amar leh abbaye: mi ka medammet
b: Haruge malchut laharuge bet din? haruge malchut, kevan deshello bedin ka mikkatli, havya lehu kappara. haruge bet din, kevan divdin ka mikkatli, la have lehu kappara.
Teda, ditnan: lo hayu kovrin oto bekivrot avotav. vei salka datach, kevan deikketul havya lehu kappara, likkavru! mita ukevura baenan.
Motev rav adda bar ahava: la hayu mitabbelin, ella onnin, sheen aninut ella ballev. vei salka datach, kevan deikkevur havya lehu kappara – liabbelu!
Baenan name ikkul basar. dayka name, dekatane: nitakkel habbasar – melakketin et haatzamot vekovrin otan bimkoman. shema minna.
Rav ashe amar: avelut meematay ka matchala? missetimat haggolel. kappara meematay ka havya? mikki chazu tzaara dekivra pureta. hilkach, hoil venidchu yiddachu.
I hachi, lema li ikkul basar? mishshum dela efshar.

Kivreh derav havo shakli minneh afra leishshata bat yoma. ato amaru leh lishmuel. amar lehu: yaut avdin, karka olam hu, vekarka olam enah neeseret, dichtiv: "vayyashlech et afarah al kever bene haam", makkish kever bene haam laavoda zara.
Ma avoda zara bimchubbar la mittasra, dichtiv: "asher attem yorshim otam et elohehem al heharim haramim". al heharim elohehem, velo heharim elohehem. hacha name, bimchubbar la mittesar.
Metivi: hachotzev kever leaviv, vehalach ukevaro bemakom acher – hare ze lo yikkaver bo olamit. hacha bemay askinan? bekever binyan.
Ta shema: kever chadash muttar bahanaa. hetil bo nefel – asur bahanaa. hacha name, bekever binyan.
Ta shema: nimtza atta omer shalosh kevarot hen – kever hannimtza, kever hayyadua, kever hammazzik et harabbim. kever hannimtza – muttar lefannoto. pinnahu – mekomo tahor umuttar bahanaa.
Kever hayyadua, asur lefannoto. pinnahu – mekomo tame veasur bahanaa.
Kever hammazzik et harabbim, muttar lefannoto. pinnahu – mekomo tahor veasur bahanaa. hacha name, bekever binyan.
Vekever hannimtza muttar lefannoto? dilma met mitzva hu, umet mitzva kana mekomo! shane met mitzva, dekala it leh.
Ittemar: haoreg beged lammet, abbaye amar: asur, verava amar: muttar.
Abbaye amar asur – hazemana milleta hi. verava amar muttar – hazemana lav milleta hi.
May tama deabbaye? gamar "sham" "sham" meegla arufa. ma egla arufa behazemana mittasra, hay name behazemana mittasra.
Verava gamar "sham" "sham" meavoda zara. ma avoda zara behazemana la mittasra, af hacha name behazemana la mittasra.
Verava, may tama la gamar meegla arufa? amar lach:

a: Meshammeshin mimmeshammeshin gamrinan, leappoke egla arufa dehi gufa kedosha.
Veabbaye, may tama la gamar meavoda zara? amar lach: midde deorcheh mimmidde deorcheh gamrinan, leappoke avoda zara delav orcha.
Siman: kippa, nafsheh, dachatziva, bekivreh deyattir meavu, bechisa deummana.
Metivi: kippa shehu tame midras unetanattu lesefer – tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. ema: netanattu ucherachattu.

Lema li netanattu ucherachattu? kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: hay sudara deazmeneh lemetzar beh tefillin, vetzar beh tefillin – asur lemetzar beh peshite. azmeneh vela tzar beh, tzar beh vela azmeneh – shere lemetzar beh peshite.
Vlabbaye deamar: hazemana milleta hi, azmeneh – af al gav dela tzar beh. tzar beh: i azmeneh – in, i la azmeneh – la.
Ta shema: nefesh shebbenao leshem chay – muttar bahanaa. hosif bo dimos echad leshem met – asur bahanaa. hacha bemay askinan? dirma beh met.
I hachi, may irya hosif? ki lo hosif name! la tzericha, af al gav defanneyeh.
Amar rafram bar pappa amar rav chisda: im haya makkiro, choltzo umuttar.
Ta shema: hachotzev kever leaviv, vehalach ukevaro bekever acher – hare ze lo yikkaver bo olamit. hatam, mishshum kevod aviv.
Hachi name mistabbera, dekatane sefa: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af hachotzev avanim leaviv vehalach ukevaro bemakom acher – hare ze lo yikkaver bahen olamit.
I amrat bishlama mishshum kevod aviv – shappir, ella i amrat mishshum hazemana: tevivy laariga mi ikka leman deamar?
Ta shema: kever chadash muttar bahanaa. hetil bo nefel – asur bahanaa. hetil – in, lo hetil – la.
Hu haddin deaf al gav dela hetil, uleappoke midderabban shimon ben gamliel deamar: en linfalim tefisat hakkever, ka mashma lan.
Ta shema: motar hammetim – lemetim, motar hammet – leyorshav. hacha bemay askinan? sheggavu mechayyim.
Ha la tane hachi, ditnan: motar hammetim – lemetim, motar hammet – leyorshav. vetane ala: ketzad? gavu lemetim setam – zehu motar hammetim lemetim, gavu lemet ze – zehu motar hammet leyorshav.
Velitamaych, ema sefa: rabbi meir omer, lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. rabbi natan omer: yaasennu dimos al kivro o zilluf lifne mittato.
Ella, abbaye metaretz letameh verava metaretz letameh. abbaye metaretz letameh: dechulle alma hazemana milleta hi. tanna kamma savar: dachaze leh – tafes, dela chaze leh – la tafes.
Verabbi meir mesappeka leh, i tafes i la tafes. hilkach, lo yigga bahen ad sheyyavo eliyyahu. verabbi natan peshita leh devadday tafes, hilkach yease dimos al kivro.
Verava metaretz letameh: lechulle alma hazemana lav milleta hi. tanna kamma savar: ki bazu leh, achole machel ziluteh gabbe yorshin.
Verabbi meir mesappeka leh i machel i la machel, hilkach lo yigga bahen kulei. verabbi natan peshita leh dela machel, hilkach yease dimos al kivro o zilluf lifne mittato.
Ta shema: hayu aviv veimmo mezarkin bo kelim, mitzva al haacherim lehatztzilan.
b: Hatam mishshum merarayyhu. i hachi, hayeynu dekatane ala: amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: bamme devarim amurim? shello nagu bammitta, aval nagu bammitta – asurin.
Targema ulla: bemitta hannikberet immo, demichallefi betachrichi hammet.
Ta shema: kis sheasao lehanniach bo tefillin – asur lehanniach bo maot. hinniach bo tefillin – yanniach bo maot. ema: asao vehinniach bo tefillin – asur lehanniach bo maot, kidrav chisda.

Ta shema: amar leumman "ase li tik shel sefer" o "nartik shel tefillin" – ad shello nishtammesh bahen kodesh, muttar lehishtammesh bahen chol. nishtammesh bahen kodesh – asur lehishtammesh bahen chol.

Tannae hi, detanya: tzippan zahav o shettala alehen or shel behema temea – pesulot. or behema tehora – kesherot, af al pi shello ibbedan lishman. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af or behema tehora pesulot, ad sheyyeabbedo lishman.
Amar leh ravina lerava: mi ikka ducheta deramu beh met, veargi beged lammet? amar leh: in, kegon shachve deharpanya.
Derash marimar: hilcheta kevavteh deabbaye, verabbanan amri: hilcheta kevavteh derava. vehilcheta kevavteh derava.

Tanu rabbanan: haruge malchut – nichsehen lammelech, haruge bet din – nichsehen layyorshin. rabbi yehuda omer: af haruge malchut nichsehen layyorshin. amaru leh lerabbi yehuda: vahalo kevar neemar "hinne becherem navot asher yarad sham lerishto"?

Amar lahen: ben achi aviv haya, verauy leyorsho haya. vahalo harebe banim hayu lo? amar lahen: oto veet banav harag, shenneemar: "im lo et deme navot veet deme vanav raiti". verabbanan? hahu banim haruyin latzet mimmennu.
Bishlama leman deamar nichsehen lammelech, hayeynu dichtiv "berach navot elohim vamelech". ella leman deamar nichsehen layyorshin, lema li "vamelech"?
Uletamaych, elohim lema li? ella leapposhe ritcha. hachi name, leapposhe ritcha.

Bishlama leman deamar: "nichsehen lammelech", hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyanos yoav el ohel Adonai vayyachazek bekarnot hammizbeach", uchetiv: "vayyomer lo etze ki po amut". ella leman deamar: "nichsehen layyorshin", may nafka leh minna? lechayye shaa.

"Vayyashev benayahu et hammelech davar lemor ko dibber yoav vecho anani". amar leh: zil ema leh: tarte la taaved behay gavra. i katlat leh, kabbevl latuteh delatyeh avuch. vei la, shivkeh deleku belatuteh delatyeh avuch. "vayyomer lo hammelech ase kaasher dibber ufega bo ukevarto".
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol kelalot shekkillel david et yoav nitkayyeymu bezaro shel david. "al yikkaret mibbet yoav zav umetzora umachazik bappelech venofel bacherev vachasar lachem".
"Zav" – merchavam, dichtiv: "vehammelech rechavam hitammetz laalot bammerkava lanus yerushalaym", uchetiv: "vechol hammerkav asher yirkav alav hazzav yitma".
"Metzora" – meuzziyyahu, dichtiv: "uvechezkato gava libbo ad lehashechit vayyimal baAdonai elohav vayyavo el hechal Adonai lehaketir al mizbach hakketoret", uchetiv: "vehatztzaraat zarcha vemitzcho".

"Machazik befelech" – measa, dichtiv: "rak leet ziknato chala et raglav." veamar rav yehuda amar rav: sheachazo podagra. amar leh mar zutera bereh derav nachman lerav nachman: hechi dame? amar leh: kemachat bivsar hachay. mena yada? i baet ema: mechash hava chayesh beh. veibbaet ema: merabbeh hava gemir la. veibbaet ema: "sod Adonai lireav uverito lehodiam".
"Nofel bacherev" – miyyoshiyyahu, dichtiv: "vayyoru hammorim lammelech yoshiyyahu". veamar rav yehuda amar rav: sheasu kol gufo kichvara.
"Vachasar lechem" – michonya, dichtiv: "vaaruchato aruchat tamid nittena lo". amar rav yehuda amar rav: hayeynu deamri inashe:

a: Tehe luta, vela tehe lata.
Atyu leyoav, dayyeyneh. amar leh: may tama ketalteh leavner? amar leh: goel haddam daasael havay. asael rodef hava. amar leh: haya lo lehatztzilo beechad meevarav.

Amar leh: la yechel leh. amar leh: hasheta bedofen chamishit kayvven leh, dichtiv "vayyakkehu avner beachare hachanit el hachomesh", veamar rabbi yochanan: bedofen chamishit, bemakom shemmara vechaved teluyin bo. beechad meevarav la yechel leh?

Amar leh: nezil avner, may tama ketalteh laamasa? amar leh: amasa mored bammalchut hava, dichtiv: "vayyomer hammelech laamasa hazeek li et ish yehuda sheloshet yamim vegomer vayyelech amasa lehazeik et yehuda vayyocher vegomer".
Amar leh: amasa "akkin" verakkin" derash.

Ashkechinhu diftiach lehu bemassechta. amar: ketiv "kol ish asher yamre et picha velo yishma et devarecha lechol asher tetzavvennu yumat". yachol afillu ledivre tora? talmud lomar: "rak chazak veematz".
Ella, hahu gavra mored bammalchut hava, dichtiv: "vehashshemua baa ad yoav ki yoav nata achare adoniyya veachare avshalom lo nata".
May "lo nata"? amar rav yehuda: shebbikkesh lintot velo nata. umay tama la nata? amar rabbi elazar: adayin lichluchit shel david kayyemet.

Rabbi yose berabbi chanina amar: adayin itztagnine shel david kayyaymin, deamar rav yehuda amar rav: arba meot yeladim hayu lo ledavid, kullan bene yefat toar hayu, umegaddele velorit hayu, umehallechin berashe haggeyaysot hayu, vehen hen baale egrofin shel david.

Ufeliga derabbi abba bar kahana, deamar rabbi abba bar kahana: ilmale david lo asa yoav milchama, veilmale yoav lo asak david battora. dichtiv: "vayhi david ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo veyoav ben tzeruya al hatztzava". ma taam "david ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo"? mishshum deyoav al hatztzava". uma taam "yoav al hatztzava"? mishshum dedavid ose mishpat utzedaka lechol ammo".
"Vayyetze yoav meim david vayyishlach malachim achare avner vayyashivu oto mibbor hassira". may "bor hassira"? amar rabbi abba bar kahana: bor vesira garmu lo leavner sheyyehareg.

"Vayyattehu yoav el toch hashshaar ledabber itto bashsheli". amar rabbi yochanan: sheddano din sanhedri. amar leh: may tama ketalteh laasael? asael rodef haya. haya lecha lehatztzilo beechad meevarav! la yecheli leh. hasheta bedofen chamishit kavvevnt leh, beechad meevarav la yechelt leh?
"Ledabber itto bashsheli", amar rav yehuda amar rav: al iske shalu. "vayyakkehu sham el hachomesh", amar rabbi yochanan: bedofen chamishit, makom shemmara vechaved teluyin bo.

"Veheshiv Adonai et damo al rosho asher paga bishne anashim tzaddikim tovim mimmennu". "tovim" – shehayu dorshin "akkin" verakkin", vehu lo darash. "tzaddikim" – shehen bappe velo asu, vehu beiggeret asa.
"Vaamasa lo nishmar bacherev asher beyad yoav". amar rav: shello chashado.

"Vayyikkaver beveto bammidbar". attu beto midbar hu? amar rav yehuda amar rav: kammidbar, ma midbar mufekar lakkol, af beto shel yoav mufekar lakkol. davar acher: kammidbar, ma midbar menukke miggazel vaarayot, af beto shel yoav menukke miggazel vaarayot. "veyoav yechayye et shear hair". amar rav yehuda: afillu munine vetzachanata taem pares lehu.
Hadaran alach nigmar haddin
b: Mishna arba mitot nimseru levet din: sekila, serefa, hereg, vachenek. rabbi shimon omer: serefa, sekila, chenek, vahereg. zo mitzvat hanniskalin.
Gemara amar rava amar rav sechora amar rav huna: kol makom sheshshanu chachamim derech minyayn, en mukedam umeuchar, chutz mishshiva sammanin.
Ditnan: shiva sammanin maavirin al hakketem – rok tafel, ume gerisin, ume raglayim, veneter, uvorit, kimolya, veashlach.
Vekatane sefa: heeviran shello kesidran, o sheheeviran shivatan keechad – lo asa velo chelum.
Rav pappa sava mishshemeh derav amar: af arba mitot. middeka mippelig rabbi shimon, shema minna davka katane. veiddach, biflugeta la ka mayyre.
Rav pappa amar: af seder yoma, ditnan: kol maase yom hakkippurim haamurim al hasseder, im hikdim maase lachavero – lo asa velo chelum.
Veiddach, hahu chumera bealma.
Rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar: af seder tamid, dekatane ala "zehu seder tamid". veiddach – hahu lemitzva bealma.
Uleappoke mimmitzvat chalitza, ditnan: mitzvat chalitza – ba hu vivimto lifne bet din, hayu notnin lo etza hahogenet lo, shenneemar: "vekaru lo zikne iro vedibberu elav".
Vehi omeret: "meen yevami vegomer", vehu omer: "lo chafatzti lekachtah". uvilshon hakkodesh hayu omrin.
"Veniggesha yevimto elav leene hazzekenim vechaltza naalo veyarka befanav" – rok hannire laddayyaynin. "veanta veamra kacha yease leish vegomer venikra shemo beyisrael vegomer".
Veamar rav yehuda: mitzvat chalitza – kora vekore, choletzet verokeket, vekora.
Vehavenan ba: may ka mashma lan? matnitin hi! ha ka mashma lan: mitzva hachi, vei afech – let lan ba. tanya name hachi: ben shehikdim chalitza lirkika, o rekika lachalitza – ma sheasa asuy.
Uleappoke meha ditnan: kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona kelim, vehedyot bearbaa. bichtonet, bemichnasayim, bemitznefet, veavnet. mosif alehen kohen gadol: choshen veefod umeil vetzitz.
Vetanya: minnayin shello yehe davar kodem lammichnasayim? shenneemar: "umichnese vad yihyu al besaro".
Vetanna, may tama akdemeh lichtonet? mishshum deakdemeh kera. ukera, may tama akdemeh? mishshum dimchasseya kulle gufeh, adifa leh.
Sekila serefa kulei. sekila chamura misserefa, shekken nittena limgaddef uleoved avoda zara. may chumera? shekken poshet yado baikkar.
Adderabba: serefa chamura, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? shekken mechallelet et aviha.

a: Kasavri rabbanan: nesua yotza lisrefa, velo arusa. umiddeappeka rachamana laarusa biskila, shema minna: sekila chamura.
Sekila chamura missayif, shekken nittena limgaddef uleoved avoda zara. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: sayif chamur, shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonan aved.
Amarta: eze koach merubbe, koach hammaddiach o koach hanniddach? heve omer: koach hammaddiach. vetanya: maddiche ir hanniddachat – biskila.
Sekila chamura mechenek, shekken nittan limgaddef uleoved avoda zara. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: chenek chamur – shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? shekken hukkash kevodan lichvod hammakom.
Middeappekeh rachamana laarusa bat yisrael mikkelal nesua bat yisrael mechenek liskila, shema minna: sekila chamura.
Serefa chamura missayif, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? shekken mechallelet et aviha.
Adderabba: sayif chamur, shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonan aved.
Neemar "aviha" biskila, veneemar "aviha" bisrefa. ma "aviha" haamur biskila – sekila chamura missayif, af "aviha" haamur bisrefa – serefa chamura missayif.
Serefa chamura mechenek, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: chenek chamur, shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? shekken hukkash kevodan lichvod hammakom.
Middeappekeh rachamana linsua bat kohen mikkelal nesua bat yisrael mechenek lisrefa, shema minna: serefa chamura.
Sayif chamur mechenek, shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonam aved.
Adderabba: chenek chamur shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? shekken hukkash kulei.
Afillu hachi, poshet yado baikkar adif.
Rabbi shimon omer kulei. serefa chamura missekila, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? shekken mechallelet et aviha.
Adderabba: sekila chamura, shekken nittena limgaddef uleoved avoda zara. umay chumera? shekken poshet yado baikkar.
Rabbi shimon letameh, deamar: achat arusa veachat nesua yatza lisrefa. umiddeappekeh rachamana laarusa bat kohen mikkelal arusa bat yisrael missekila lisrefa, shema minna: serefa chamura.
Serefa chamura mechenek, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: chenek chamur, shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? shekken hukkash kevodam lichvod hammakom.
Middeappekeh rachamana linsua bat kohen mikkelal nesua bat yisrael, mechenek lisrefa, shema minna: serefa chamura.
Serefa chamura missayif, shekken nittena levat kohen shezzinneta. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: sayif chamur, shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonam aved.
Amarta: vechi eze koach merubbe, koach hammaddiach o koach hanniddach?
b: Heve omer: koach hammaddiach. vekal vachomer: uma chenek, shechamur missayif – serefa chamura mimmennu; sayif hakkal – lo kol shekken?
Sekila chamura mechenek, shekken nittena limgaddef uleoved avoda zara. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: chenek chamur, shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? shekken hukkash kulei.
Middeappekeh rachamana laarusa bat yisrael mikkelal nesua bat yisrael mechenek liskila, shema minna: sekila chamura.
Sekila chamura missayif, shekken nittena lamgaddef kulei. adderabba: sayif chamur shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonam aved.

Amarta: vechi eze koach merubbe, koach hammaddiach o koach hanniddach? heve omer koach hammaddiach. vekal vachomer: uma chenek shechamur missayif, sekila chamura mimmennu; sayif hakkal – lo kol shekken?
Chenek chamur missayif, shekken nittan lemakke aviv veimmo. umay chumera? kedaamaran.
Adderabba: sayif chamur shekken nittan leanshe ir hanniddachat. umay chumera? shekken mamonam aved.
Amarta: vechi eze koach merubbe, koach hammaddiach o koach hanniddach? heve omer: koach hammaddiach. vetanya: maddiche ir hanniddachat biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bechenek.
Margela befummeh derabbi yochanan: naara hameorasa bat kohen shezzinneta – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bisrefa. zinneta meaviha – biskila. rabbi shimon omer: bisrefa.

May ka mashma lan? lerabbanan – nesua yatza lisrefa, velo arusa. lerabbi shimon – achat arusa veachat nesua yatza lisrefa. vetama may? mishshum dilrabbanan sekila chamura, lerabbi shimon serefa chamura.
Nafka minna lemi shennitchayyev shete mitot bet din, niddon bachamura.
May rabbi shimon? detanya: rabbi shimon omer, shene kelalot neemru bevat kohen.
Bevat kohen, velo bevat yisrael?! ema: af bevat kohen.
Vehotzi hakkatuv nesua mikkelal nesua, vaarusa mikkelal arusa.
Ma keshehotzi hakkatuv nesua mikkelal nesua lehachemir, af keshehotzi hakkatuv arusa mikkelal arusa lehachamir.
Zomme nesua bat kohen, bichlal zomme nesua bat yisrael; vezomme arusa bat kohen, bichlal zomme arusa bat yisrael.
Tanu rabbanan: "uvat ish kohen ki techel" – yachol afillu chillela et hashshabbat? talmud lomar "liznot" – bechillulin shebbiznut hakkatuv medabber.
Yachol afillu penuya? neemar kan "aviha", veneemar lehallan "aviha". ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal, af kan zenut im zikat habbaal.
O eno omer "aviha" ella lehotzi et kol haadam? keshehu omer "hi mechallelet", heve kol adam amur.
Ha ma ani mekayyem "aviha"? neemar kan "aviha", veneemar lehallan "aviha". ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal, af kan zenut im zikat habbaal.
I ma lehallan naara vehi arusa, af kan naara vehi arusa? naara vehi nesua, bogeret vehi arusa, bogeret vehi nesua, vaafillu hizkina – minnayin?
Talmud lomar "uvat kohen" – mikkol makom.
"Bat kohen",

a: En li ella shennisset lechohen. nisset lelevi uleyisrael, lechuti, lechalal, lemamzer ulenatin – minnayin? talmud lomar: "uvat ish kohen", af al pi sheenah kohenet.
"Hi" bisrefa, veen boalah bisrefa. "hi" bisrefa, veen zommeha bisrefa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: et aviha bisrefa, veet chamiha biskila.
Amar mar: yachol afillu chillela shabbat? chillela shabbat – bat sekila hi!
Amar rava: ha manni? rabbi shimon hi, deamar serefa chamura. salka datach amena: hoil veachmer behu rachamana bechahane, derabbi behu mitzvot yeterot – tiddon bisrefa! ka mashma lan.
May shena minneh dideh?
Salka datach amena: ihu, deishtarya leh shabbat legabbe avoda; hi, kevan dela ishtarya shabbat legabba, ema tiddon bisrefa. ka mashma lan.
Yachol afillu penuya? ha "liznot" ketiv!
Kidrabbi elazar, deamar: panuy habba al happenuya shello leshum ishut – asaah zona.
O eno omer "aviha" ella lehotzi et kol adam? ella may nihu – shezzinneta meaviha? may irya bat kohen? afillu bat yisrael name!
Deamar rava: amar li rav yitzchak bar avudimi, atya "henna" "henna".
Atya "zimma" "zimma".
Itzterich, salka datach amena: kera leappoke midderava, middegalli rachamana bevat kohen velo bevat yisrael. ka mashma lan.
Bat kohen – en li ella shennisset lechohen. nisset lelevi, leyisrael, ulechuti, ulechallel, lenatin, ulemamzer minnayin? talmud lomar: "bat ish kohen" – af al pi sheenah kohenet.
Mishshum deinnasva lehu lehane, lav bat kohen hi? vetu, midde "kohenet lechohen" ketiv?
Salka datach amena: ki "techel liznot" amar rachamana, hane mille hecha deka matchala hasheta, aval ha, kevan deka matchala vekayyma meikkara.
Deamar mar: "uvat kohen ki tihye leish zar", kevan shennivala lefasul lah – pesalah.
Lelevi veyisrael name, "veshava el bet aviha kinureha", mikkelal dechi iteh gabbeh la achla,
Ema: la tiddon bisrefa. ka mashma lan.
Udela kerabbi meir, detanya: bat kohen shennisset leyisrael veachla teruma – meshallemet et hakkeren veenah meshallemet et hachomesh, umitatah bisrefa.
Nisset leechad min happesulin – meshallemet keren vachomesh, umitatah bechenek. divre rabbi meir.
Vachachamim omrim: zo vazo meshallemot keren velo chomesh, umitatan bisrefa.
Rabbi eliezer omer: et aviha – bisrefa, veet chamiha – biskila. may et aviha veet chamiha?
Illema: et aviha – meaviha, veet chamiha – mechamiha, may irya bat kohen? afillu bat yisrael name! bitto – bisrefa, vechallato – biskila.
Ella, et aviha – birshut aviha, veet chamiha – birshut chamiha.
Keman? i kerabbanan, haamri: nesua yatzat lisrefa velo arusa. i kerabbi shimon, haamar: achat arusa veachat nesua bisrefa.
Vei kerabbi yishmael, haamar: arusa yatzat lisrefa, velo nesua. et chamiha – chenek hu!

Shelach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina: kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna, leolam kerabbanan, vehachi kaamar: kol shehiv lematta mimmitat aviha – umay nihu? nesua bat yisrael. deillu nesua bat yisrael bechenek, hacha bemitat aviha bisrefa.
Kol shehi lemala mimmitat aviha, umay nihu? arusa bat yisrael. deillu arusa bat yisrael bealma biskila, hacha bemitat chamiha biskila.
Matkef la rabbi yirmeya: midde "lemala" "lematta" katane? ella, amar rabbi yirmeya:
b: Leolam kerabbi yishmael, vehachi kaamar: et aviha – birshut aviha, bisrefa; veet chamiha – mechamiha, biskila; vechol adam – bechenek.
Amar rava: may shena? o idde veidde mammash, o idde veidde reshut.
Ella amar rava: leolam kerabbi shimon, vekasavar rabbi eliezer nesua kaarusa. ma arusa chad darga massekinan la, missekila lisrefa, af nesua chad darga massekinan la, mechenek liskila.
Matkef la rabbi chanina: ha idde veidde rabbi shimon bisrefa kaamar?
Ella amar ravina: leolam kerabbanan, veefoch – et aviha biskila, veet chamiha bisrefa. vehay dekaamar "et aviha" – sircha bealma naket.
Amar rav nachman, amar rabba bar avu, amar rav: halacha kedishlach ravin mishshemeh derabbi yose berabbi chanina. amar rav yosef: hilcheta limshicha?
Amar leh abbaye: ella meatta, shechitat kodashim la litne? hilcheta limshicha! ella, derosh vekabbel sachar. hacha name, derosh vekabbel sachar.
Hachi kaamri: hilcheta lema li? sugeya dishmata halacha kaamar.
May rabbi yishmael? detanya: "uvat [ish] kohen ki techel liznot" – benaara vehi arusa hakkatuv medabber.

Atta omer benaara vehi arusa, o eno ella afillu nesua? talmud lomar: "ish asher yinaf et eshet reehu mot yumat hannoef vehannoafet". hakkol hayu bichlal "hannoef vehannoefet". hotzi hakkatuv bat yisrael biskila uvat kohen bisrefa. ma keshehotzi hakkatuv et bat yisrael liskila – arusa velo nesua, af keshehotzi hakkatuv bat kohen lisrefa – arusa velo nesua.
Zommeha uvoalah bichlal "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam vegomer".
Boalah – may "kaasher zamam" ikka? ella: zommeha bichlal mitat boalah.
Mishshum shenneemar: "vaasitem lo kaasher zamam laasot leachiv", velo laachoto. divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: achat arusa veachat nesua yatzat lisrefa. yachol afillu penuya? neemar kan "aviha", veneemar lehallan "aviha". ma lehallan zenut im zikat habbaal, af kan zenut im zikat habbaal.
Amar lo rabbi yishmael: i, ma lehallan naara vehi arusa, af kan naara vehi arusa.
Amar lo rabbi akiva: yishmael achi, "bat" "uvat" ani doresh.
Amar lo: vechi mippene sheatta doresh "bat" "uvat" notzi zo lisrefa? im mashma lehavi et hannesua, have et happenuya; veim mashma lehotzi et happenuya, hotze et hannesua.
Verabbi akiva, ahani gezera shava lemaote penuya, veahani "bat" "uvat" lerabbot et hannesua.
Verabbi yishmael savar: middekaamar leh "bat" "uvat", shema minna hadar beh miggezera shava.

Verabbi yishmael, hay "bat" "uvat" may daresh beh? mibbee leh lechidtane avu dishmuel bar avin: lefi shemmatzinu shechillek hakkatuv bizcharim ben temimim levaale mumin, yachol nachlok bivnotehen? talmud lomar: "bat" "uvat".
Verabbi akiva min "hem makrivim vehayu kodesh" nafka.
Verabbi yishmael, i mehahi hava amena: hane mille inhu, aval benotehen la. ka mashma lan.
